1.en: June 2004 saw the first passage, known as a ‘transit’, of the planet Venus across the face of the Sun in 122 years.
parts: 2004年6月，金星从日面前经过，这是122年来首次出现这种称为“凌日”的现象。

2.en: Transits have helped shape our view of the whole Universe, as Heather Cooper and Nigel Henbest explain
parts: 正如希瑟·库珀和奈杰尔·亨贝斯特所解释的那样，凌日现象帮助我们形成了对整个宇宙的认识。

3.en: On 8 June 2004, more than half the population of the world were treated to a rare astronomical event.
parts: 2004年6月8日，世界上超过一半的人有幸目睹了一次罕见的天象。

4.en: For over six hours, the planet Venus steadily inched its way over the surface of the Sun.
parts: 在六个多小时里，金星一点一点地移过日面。

5.en: This ‘transit’ of Venus was the first since 6 December 1882.
parts: 这是自1882年12月6日以来首次出现金星凌日。

6.en: On that occasion, the American astronomer Professor Simon Newcomb led a party to South Africa to observe the event.
parts: 那一次，美国天文学家西蒙·纽康教授率领一队人前往南非观测这一天象。

7.en: They were based at a girls’ school, where - it is alleged - the combined forces of three schoolmistresses outperformed the professionals with the accuracy of their observations.
parts: 他们以一所女子学校为驻地，
据说，那里的三位女教师通力合作，观测结果比专业人士的还要准确。

8.en: For centuries, transits of Venus have drawn explorers and astronomers alike to the four corners of the globe.
parts: 几个世纪以来，金星凌日吸引着探险家和天文学家奔赴世界各地。
terms: the four corners of the globe
the four corners of the globe

9.en: And you can put it all down to the extraordinary polymath Edmond Halley.
parts: 而这一切都可归功于非凡的博学之士埃德蒙·哈雷。

10.en: In November 1677, Halley observed a transit of the innermost planet, Mercury, from the desolate island of St Helena in the South Pacific.
parts: 1677年11月，哈雷在南太平洋荒凉的圣赫勒拿岛上观测到了水星凌日。水星是离太阳最近的行星。

11.en: He realised that, from different latitudes, the passage of the planet across the Sun’s disc would appear to differ.
parts: 他意识到，从不同纬度观察，行星在日面上经过的路径看起来会有所不同。

12.en: By timing the transit from two widely-separated locations, teams of astronomers could calculate the parallax angle - the apparent difference in position of an astronomical body due to a difference in the observer’s position.
parts: 天文学家们可以在两个相距很远的地点分别为凌日计时，据此算出视差角，
也就是因观测者位置不同而造成的天体视位置之差。

13.en: Calculating this angle would allow astronomers to measure what was then the ultimate goal: the distance of the Earth from the Sun.
parts: 算出这个角度，天文学家就能测出他们当时最想知道的距离，也就是地球与太阳之间的距离。

14.en: This distance is known as the ‘astronomical unit’ or AU.
parts: 这个距离称为“天文单位”，简称AU。

15.en: Halley was aware that the AU was one of the most fundamental of all astronomical measurements.
parts: 哈雷知道，天文单位是所有天文测量值中最基本的指标之一。

16.en: Johannes Kepler, in the early 17th century, had shown that the distances of the planets from the Sun governed their orbital speeds, which were easily measurable.
parts: 早在17世纪初，约翰内斯·开普勒就已证明，行星与太阳之间的距离决定了它们的公转速度，而公转速度很容易测量。

17.en: But no-one had found a way to calculate accurate distances to the planets from the Earth.
parts: 但当时还没有人找到准确计算地球到各行星距离的方法。

18.en: The goal was to measure the AU; then, knowing the orbital speeds of all the other planets round the Sun, the scale of the Solar System would fall into place.
parts: 目标是测出一个天文单位有多长。
有了这个距离，再知道其他各行星绕太阳运行的速度，太阳系的尺度便可随之确定。

19.en: However, Halley realised that Mercury was so far away that its parallax angle would be very difficult to determine.
parts: 然而，哈雷意识到，水星距离地球很远，要测定它的视差角会非常困难。

20.en: As Venus was closer to the Earth, its parallax angle would be larger, and Halley worked out that by using Venus it would be possible to measure the Sun’s distance to 1 part in 500.
parts: 由于金星离地球更近，它的视差角会更大。
哈雷算出，借助金星来测量日地距离，精度有望达到五百分之一。

21.en: But there was a problem: transits of Venus, unlike those of Mercury, are rare, occurring in pairs roughly eight years apart every hundred or so years.
parts: 但有一个困难。与水星凌日不同，金星凌日很少发生，
大约每隔一百年才成对出现，同一对的两次凌日相隔约八年。

22.en: Nevertheless, he accurately predicted that Venus would cross the face of the Sun in both 1761 and 1769 - though he didn’t survive to see either.
parts: 尽管如此，他还是准确预言金星会在1761年和1769年两度掠过日面，只是他没能活到亲眼见证其中任何一次。

23.en: Inspired by Halley’s suggestion of a way to pin down the scale of the Solar System, teams of British and French astronomers set out on expeditions to places as diverse as India and Siberia.
parts: 哈雷提出了一种确定太阳系尺度的方法。受此启发，
英法两国的天文学家组队远行，前往印度、西伯利亚等迥然不同的地方考察。

24.en: But things weren’t helped by Britain and France being at war.
parts: 但英法两国当时正在交战，这使事情更不顺利。

25.en: The person who deserves most sympathy is the French astronomer Guillaume Le Gentil.
parts: 最值得同情的是法国天文学家纪尧姆·勒让蒂。

26.en: He was thwarted by the fact that the British were besieging his observation site at Pondicherry in India.
parts: 由于英军当时正在围困他位于印度本地治里的观测点，他的计划受了阻。

27.en: Fleeing on a French warship crossing the Indian Ocean, Le Gentil saw a wonderful transit - but the ship’s pitching and rolling ruled out any attempt at making accurate observations.
parts: 勒让蒂搭上一艘横渡印度洋的法国军舰撤离，在船上目睹了一次壮观的金星凌日。
但船身前后颠簸、左右摇晃，他根本无法进行准确观测。

28.en: Undaunted, he remained south of the equator, keeping himself busy by studying the islands of Mauritius and Madagascar before setting off to observe the next transit in the Philippines.
parts: 他没有气馁，继续留在赤道以南。
他先忙于考察毛里求斯岛和马达加斯加岛，随后动身前往菲律宾，准备观测下一次凌日。

29.en: Ironically after travelling nearly 50,000 kilometres, his view was clouded out at the last moment, a very dispiriting experience.
parts: 颇具讽刺意味的是，他奔波了近五万公里，最后关头却被云层挡住了视线，实在令人沮丧。

30.en: While the early transit timings were as precise as instruments would allow, the measurements were dogged by the ‘black drop’ effect.
parts: 早期的凌日计时已经达到了当时仪器所能达到的精度，测量结果却一直受到“黑滴效应”的干扰。

31.en: When Venus begins to cross the Sun’s disc, it looks smeared not circular - which makes it difficult to establish timings.
parts: 金星开始掠过日面时，看上去轮廓模糊，不呈圆形，因此很难准确判定时间。

32.en: This is due to diffraction of light.
parts: 这是光的衍射造成的。

33.en: The second problem is that Venus exhibits a halo of light when it is seen just outside the Sun’s disc.
parts: 第二个问题是，当人们看到金星刚好位于日面以外时，它的周围会出现一圈光晕。

34.en: While this showed astronomers that Venus was surrounded by a thick layer of gases refracting sunlight around it, both effects made it impossible to obtain accurate timings.
parts: 这固然让天文学家看出，金星周围包裹着一层厚厚的气体，这些气体使阳光在金星周围发生折射，
但这两种效应使人无法准确计时。

35.en: But astronomers laboured hard to analyse the results of these expeditions to observe Venus transits.
parts: 尽管如此，天文学家仍投入了大量精力，分析这些远征观测金星凌日所得的结果。

36.en: Johann Franz Encke, Director of the Berlin Observatory, finally determined a value for the AU based on all these parallax measurements: 153,340,000 km.
parts: 柏林天文台台长约翰·弗朗茨·恩克综合所有这些视差测量结果，终于算出一个天文单位的长度为153,340,000公里。

37.en: Reasonably accurate for the time, that is quite close to today’s value of 149,597,870 km, determined by radar, which has now superseded transits and all other methods in accuracy.
parts: 以当时的条件衡量，这个数值相当准确，与如今用雷达测得的149,597,870公里非常接近。
就精度而言，雷达测量如今已胜过凌日观测和其他所有方法。

38.en: The AU is a cosmic measuring rod, and the basis of how we scale the Universe today.
parts: 天文单位就像一把宇宙量尺，是我们今天衡量宇宙尺度的基础。

39.en: The parallax principle can be extended to measure the distances to the stars.
parts: 视差原理还可以推广，用于测量恒星与我们的距离。

40.en: If we look at a star in January - when Earth is at one point in its orbit - it will seem to be in a different position from where it appears six months later.
parts: 假设我们在一月观测一颗恒星，此时地球位于其公转轨道上的某一点，
那么这颗恒星看上去的位置会与六个月后看到的不同。

41.en: Knowing the width of Earth’s orbit, the parallax shift lets astronomers calculate the distance.
parts: 知道了地球轨道的宽度，天文学家就可以利用视差所造成的视位置偏移算出恒星的距离。

42.en: June 2004’s transit of Venus was thus more of an astronomical spectacle than a scientifically important event.
parts: 所以，2004年6月的金星凌日更像是一场天文奇观，其科学意义相对有限。

43.en: But such transits have paved the way for what might prove to be one of the most vital breakthroughs in the cosmos - detecting Earth-sized planets orbiting other stars.
parts: 不过，历次凌日观测为一项可能跻身宇宙探索最重大突破之列的发现铺平了道路，
那就是探测绕其他恒星运行、大小与地球相当的行星。

1.en: A millennium ago, stepwells were fundamental to life in the driest parts of India.
parts: 一千年前，在印度最干旱的地区，阶梯井对当地人的生活至关重要。

2.en: Richard Cox travelled to north-western India to document these spectacular monuments from a bygone era
parts: 理查德·考克斯前往印度西北部，记录这些昔日留下的壮观古迹。

3.en: During the sixth and seventh centuries, the inhabitants of the modern-day states of Gujarat and Rajasthan in north-western India developed a method of gaining access to clean, fresh groundwater during the dry season for drinking, bathing, watering animals and irrigation.
parts: 公元6至7世纪，今印度西北部古吉拉特邦和拉贾斯坦邦一带的居民想出了一种办法，可以在旱季取得清洁的地下淡水，
用来饮用、洗澡、给牲畜饮水和灌溉。

6.en: During their heyday, they were places of gathering, of leisure and relaxation and of worship for villagers of all but the lowest classes.
parts: 在阶梯井的鼎盛时期，这些井是除社会最底层以外各阶层村民聚会、休闲放松和礼拜的场所。

10.en: When the water level was high, the user needed only to descend a few steps to reach it; when it was low, several levels would have to be negotiated.
parts: 水位高时，用水的人只需下几级台阶就能取到水；
水位低时，则得向下走好几层。

37.en: Tourists flock to wells in far-flung corners of north-western India to gaze in wonder at these architectural marvels from hundreds of years ago, which serve as a reminder of both the ingenuity and artistry of ancient civilisations and of the value of water to human existence.
parts: 游客纷纷涌向印度西北部偏远地区的古井，惊叹于这些建于数百年前的建筑奇观。
它们既让人想起古代文明的创造力与艺术才华，也提醒人们水对人类生存的重要性。

5.en: Unique to this region, stepwells are often architecturally complex and vary widely in size and shape.
parts: 阶梯井为这一地区所特有，建筑结构往往很复杂，大小和形状也各不相同。

28.en: One of the larger examples is Raniji Ki Baori, which was built by the queen of the region, Nathavatji, in 1699.
parts: 较大的阶梯井中有一座叫拉尼吉阶梯井，由当地王后纳塔瓦特吉于1699年修建。

29.en: At 46 metres deep, 20 metres wide and 40 metres long, the intricately carved monument is one of 21 baoris commissioned in the Bundi area by Nathavatji.
parts: 这座古迹深46米、宽20米、长40米，雕刻精细，是纳塔瓦特吉在本迪一带委托修建的21座阶梯井之一。

30.en: In the old ruined town of Abhaneri, about 95 kilometres east of Jaipur, is Chand Baori, one of India’s oldest and deepest wells; aesthetically it’s perhaps one of the most dramatic.
parts: 斋浦尔以东约95公里处是阿巴内里古镇的遗址。昌德阶梯井坐落于此，是印度最古老、最深的井之一；
论外观，它或许也是最壮观的井之一。

31.en: Built in around 850 AD next to the temple of Harshat Mata, the baori comprises hundreds of zigzagging steps that run along three of its sides, steeply descending 11 storeys, resulting in a striking pattern when seen from afar.
parts: 这座阶梯井约建于公元850年，紧邻哈沙特·玛塔神庙。数百级台阶沿井的三面呈之字形排列，
陡然向下延伸十一层，从远处看，形成一幅引人注目的图案。

32.en: On the fourth side, verandas which are supported by ornate pillars overlook the steps.
parts: 在井的第四面，装饰华丽的柱子支撑着游廊，从廊上可以俯瞰台阶。

33.en: Still in public use is Neemrana Ki Baori located just off the Jaipur-Delhi highway.
parts: 尼姆拉纳阶梯井就在斋浦尔至德里的公路旁，至今仍供公众使用。

34.en: Constructed in around 1700, it is nine storeys deep, with the last two being underwater.
parts: 这口井约建于1700年，有九层深，最下面两层浸在水中。

35.en: At ground level, there are 86 colonnaded openings from where the visitor descends 170 steps to the deepest water source.
parts: 在地面这一层，有86个带柱廊的入口。游客从这里往下走170级台阶，就能到达最深处的水源。

36.en: Today, following years of neglect, many of these monuments to medieval engineering have been saved by the Archaeological Survey of India, which has recognised the importance of preserving them as part of the country’s rich history.
parts: 这些见证中世纪工程技艺的古迹曾长期无人照管。如今，印度考古局已抢救了其中许多座。
该局已认识到，这些古迹是印度丰富历史的一部分，保护它们十分重要。

4.en: However, the significance of this invention - the stepwell - goes beyond its utilitarian application.
parts: 不过，阶梯井这项发明的意义超出了它的实际用途。

9.en: As their name suggests, stepwells comprise a series of stone steps descending from ground level to the water source (normally an underground aquifer) as it recedes following the rains.
parts: 顾名思义，阶梯井由一连串从地面向下延伸的石阶构成，
一直通往水源（通常是地下含水层），水位在雨季过后会逐渐下降。

15.en: Down the centuries, thousands of wells were constructed throughout north-western India, but the majority have now fallen into disuse; many are derelict and dry, as groundwater has been diverted for industrial use and the wells no longer reach the water table.
parts: 几个世纪以来，印度西北部各地修建了数千口井，但如今大多数已停用。
许多井年久失修，已经干涸，因为地下水被引作工业用水，井底已经够不到地下水面。

14.en: But perhaps the most impressive features are the intricate decorative sculptures that embellish many stepwells, showing activities from fighting and dancing to everyday acts such as women combing their hair or churning butter.
parts: 不过，最引人注目的或许是点缀着许多阶梯井的那些精巧而繁复的装饰雕刻，
上面刻画的活动从战斗、舞蹈，到女子梳头、搅制黄油等日常生活场景，无所不包。

18.en: In Patan, the state’s ancient capital, the stepwell of Rani Ki Vav (Queen’s Stepwell) is perhaps the finest current example.
parts: 在该邦的古都帕坦，拉尼·基·瓦夫阶梯井（王后阶梯井）或许是现存最出色的实例。

27.en: The ancient city of Bundi, 200 kilometres south of Jaipur, is renowned for its architecture, including its stepwells.
parts: 本迪古城位于斋浦尔以南200公里，以建筑闻名，其中就包括阶梯井。

7.en: Most stepwells are found dotted round the desert areas of Gujarat (where they are called vav) and Rajasthan (where they are called baori), while a few also survive in Delhi.
parts: 大多数阶梯井散布在古吉拉特邦和拉贾斯坦邦的沙漠地带，在前者称为vav，在后者称为baori；
德里也留存着少数几口。

8.en: Some were located in or near villages as public spaces for the community; others were positioned beside roads as resting places for travellers.
parts: 有些阶梯井位于村中或村旁，是当地居民的公共活动场所；另一些则设在路旁，供旅人歇脚。

11.en: Some wells are vast, open craters with hundreds of steps paving each sloping side, often in tiers.
parts: 有些井是巨大的露天深坑，每一面斜坡上都铺着数百级台阶，台阶往往分层排列。

12.en: Others are more elaborate, with long stepped passages leading to the water via several storeys.
parts: 另一些井的构造更为复杂，长长的阶梯通道穿过数层，通往水面。

13.en: Built from stone and supported by pillars, they also included pavilions that sheltered visitors from the relentless heat.
parts: 这些井以石材砌成，由石柱支撑，还设有亭阁，供访客躲避持续的酷热。

16.en: Their condition hasn’t been helped by recent dry spells: southern Rajasthan suffered an eight-year drought between 1996 and 2004.
parts: 近年的一段段干旱也无助于改善这些井的状况。1996年至2004年间，拉贾斯坦邦南部经历了长达八年的旱灾。

17.en: However, some important sites in Gujarat have recently undergone major restoration, and the state government announced in June last year that it plans to restore the stepwells throughout the state.
parts: 不过，古吉拉特邦一些重要遗址最近已得到大规模修复。
去年6月，邦政府宣布计划修复全邦的阶梯井。

19.en: It was built by Queen Udayamati during the late 11th century, but became silted up following a flood during the 13th century.
parts: 这座井由乌达亚玛蒂王后于11世纪末修建，后来因13世纪的一场洪水而淤塞。

20.en: But the Archaeological Survey of India began restoring it in the 1960s, and today it is in pristine condition.
parts: 不过，印度考古局从20世纪60年代开始修复这座井，如今它已完好如初。

21.en: At 65 metres long, 20 metres wide and 27 metres deep, Rani Ki Vav features 500 sculptures carved into niches throughout the monument.
parts: 拉尼·基·瓦夫阶梯井长65米、宽20米、深27米，遍布井内的壁龛中刻有500尊雕像。

22.en: Incredibly, in January 2001, this ancient structure survived an earthquake that measured 7.6 on the Richter scale.
parts: 令人难以置信的是，这座古建筑在2001年1月一场里氏7.6级的地震中幸存了下来。

23.en: Another example is the Surya Kund in Modhera, northern Gujarat, next to the Sun Temple, built by King Bhima I in 1026 to honour the sun god Surya.
parts: 另一个例子是古吉拉特邦北部莫德赫拉的苏里亚昆德池，紧邻太阳神庙。
这座神庙由比马一世于1026年为敬奉太阳神苏里亚而建。

24.en: It actually resembles a tank (kund means reservoir or pond) rather than a well, but displays the hallmarks of stepwell architecture, including four sides of steps that descend to the bottom in a stunning geometrical formation.
parts: 它其实更像一座蓄水池（kund意为水库或池塘），而不像一口井，
但它展现了阶梯井建筑的典型特征，例如四面的台阶一直向下延伸到池底，构成令人惊叹的几何图案。

25.en: The terraces house 108 small, intricately carved shrines between the sets of steps.
parts: 各组台阶之间的平台上，有108座雕刻精细的小神龛。

26.en: Rajasthan also has a wealth of wells.
parts: 拉贾斯坦邦也有大量这样的井。

14.en: A substantial proportion of the population of modern societies engages in such tourist practices new socialised forms of provision have developed in order to cope with the mass character of the gazes of tourists as opposed to the individual character of travel.
parts: 现代社会有相当一部分人参加这类旅游活动。
新的社会化服务形式已经出现，用以适应游客观光的大众性；与之相对，旅行具有个体性。

4.en: However, there are interesting parallels with the study of deviance.
parts: 不过，这种研究与对越轨行为的研究之间，却有一些值得注意的相似之处。

22.en: Historically, textile dyes were made from such natural sources as plants and animal excretions.
parts: 过去，人们用植物、动物排泄物等天然原料制作纺织染料。

23.en: Some of these, such as the glandular mucus of snails, were difficult to obtain and outrageously expensive.
parts: 有些原料很难取得，例如蜗牛腺体分泌的黏液，而且价格贵得惊人。

24.en: Indeed, the purple colour extracted from a snail was once so costly that in society at the time only the rich could afford it.
parts: 确实，从蜗牛中提取的紫色染料一度十分昂贵，当时社会上只有富人才买得起。

25.en: Further, natural dyes tended to be muddy in hue and fade quickly.
parts: 此外，天然染料的色调往往暗浊，而且褪色很快。

28.en: Realising the importance of this breakthrough, he lost no time in patenting it.
parts: 意识到这一突破的重要性，他立即为这项发现申请了专利。

29.en: But perhaps the most fascinating of all Perkin’s reactions to his find was his nearly instant recognition that the new dye had commercial possibilities.
parts: 不过，在珀金对这一发现的种种反应中，或许最耐人寻味的是，他几乎立刻就意识到这种新染料具有商业潜力。

34.en: Utilising the cheap and plentiful coal tar that was an almost unlimited byproduct of London’s gas street lighting, the dye works began producing the world’s first synthetically dyed material in 1857.
parts: 利用廉价而充足的煤焦油——伦敦的煤气路灯照明几乎源源不断地产生这种副产品——
这家染料厂于1857年开始生产世界上第一种用合成染料染色的布料。

30.en: Perkin originally named his dye Tyrian Purple, but it later became commonly known as mauve (from the French for the plant used to make the colour violet).
parts: 珀金最初把自己的染料命名为“泰尔紫”，
后来人们普遍称它为“锦葵紫”（mauve）。这个名字来自法语中一种植物的名称，那种植物可用来制取紫色。

31.en: He asked advice of Scottish dye works owner Robert Pullar, who assured him that manufacturing the dye would be well worth it if the colour remained fast (i.e. would not fade) and the cost was relatively low.
parts: 他向苏格兰染料厂厂主罗伯特·普拉尔请教。
普拉尔向他保证，生产这种染料很值得，
条件是染出的颜色牢固（也就是不会褪色），而且成本相对较低。

6.en: His talent and devotion to the subject were perceived by his teacher, Thomas Hall, who encouraged him to attend a series of lectures given by the eminent scientist Michael Faraday at the Royal Institution.
parts: 老师托马斯·霍尔看出了他的天赋和对这门学科的热爱，
鼓励他到英国皇家研究院听杰出科学家迈克尔·法拉第的一系列讲座。

11.en: At the time, quinine was the only viable medical treatment for malaria.
parts: 当时，奎宁是治疗疟疾唯一切实可行的药物。

19.en: Incorporating potassium dichromate and alcohol into the aniline at various stages of the experimental process, he finally produced a deep purple solution.
parts: 他在实验的不同阶段将重铬酸钾和酒精加入苯胺，最终得到了一种深紫色溶液。

20.en: And, proving the truth of the famous scientist Louis Pasteur’s words ‘chance favours only the prepared mind’.
parts: 这也印证了著名科学家路易·巴斯德的那句话：“机遇只垂青有准备的头脑。”

36.en: Very soon, mauve was the necessary shade for all the fashionable ladies in that country.
parts: 很快，苯胺紫就成了那个国家所有时髦女士的必备色。

42.en: It is important to note that Perkin’s synthetic dye discoveries had outcomes far beyond the merely decorative.
parts: 值得注意的是，珀金发现合成染料所带来的影响，远远超出了单纯的装饰用途。

44.en: For instance, they were used to stain previously invisible microbes and bacteria, allowing researchers to identify such bacilli as tuberculosis, cholera, and anthrax.
parts: 例如，这些染料可以给原先看不见的微生物和细菌染色，使研究人员能够辨认出导致结核病、霍乱和炭疽的杆菌。

26.en: Sure enough, these amphibious species show up on the triangular graph approximately half way between the ‘wet cluster’ of sea turtles and the ‘dry cluster’ of land tortoises.
parts: 果然，这些水陆两栖物种在三角图上的位置，大致介于海龟的“水生点群”和陆龟的“陆生点群”正中间。

28.en: The bones of P. quenstedti and P. talampayensis leave us in no doubt.
parts: P. quenstedti 和 P. talampayensis 这两种龟的骨骼让我们确信无疑。

29.en: Their points on the graph are right in the thick of the dry cluster.
parts: 它们在图上的点正落在陆生点群的密集处。

32.en: You might think, therefore, that modern land tortoises have probably stayed on land ever since those early terrestrial times, as most mammals did after a few of them went back to the sea.
parts: 因此，你也许会认为，自那个早期陆生阶段以来，现代陆龟很可能一直生活在陆地上；
正如在少数哺乳动物重返海洋之后，大多数哺乳动物一直留在陆地上一样。

34.en: If you draw out the family tree of all modern turtles and tortoises, nearly all the branches are aquatic.
parts: 如果画出所有现代水龟和陆龟的系统树，就会发现几乎所有分支都是水生的。

36.en: This suggests that modern land tortoises have not stayed on land continuously since the time of P. quenstedti and P. talampayensis.
parts: 这表明，自 P. quenstedti 和 P. talampayensis 所生活的时代以来，现代陆龟并非一直生活在陆地上。

2.en: At various points in evolutionary history, enterprising individuals within many different animal groups moved out onto the land, sometimes even to the most parched deserts, taking their own private seawater with them in blood and cellular fluids.
parts: 在进化史的不同时期，许多不同动物类群中都有敢于探索的个体从海里走上陆地，
有时甚至进入最干旱的沙漠。它们随身带着各自的那份“海水”，就在血液和细胞液里。

22.en: Walter Joyce and Jacques Gauthier, at Yale University, obtained three measurements in these particular bones of 71 species of living turtles and tortoises.
parts: 耶鲁大学的沃尔特·乔伊斯和雅克·戈捷
测量了71种现生水龟和陆龟的这些特定骨骼，取得了三项测量值。

3.en: In addition to the reptiles, birds, mammals and insects which we see all around us, other groups that have succeeded out of water include scorpions, snails, crustaceans such as woodlice and land crabs, millipedes and centipedes, spiders and various worms.
parts: 除了我们随处可见的爬行动物、鸟类、哺乳动物和昆虫，
其他成功适应陆地生活的类群还包括蝎子、蜗牛、鼠妇和陆蟹等甲壳动物，
以及千足虫、蜈蚣、蜘蛛和各种蠕虫。

9.en: Whales (including the small whales we call dolphins) and dugongs, with their close cousins the manatees, ceased to be land creatures altogether and reverted to the full marine habits of their remote ancestors.
parts: 鲸类（包括我们称为海豚的小型鲸类），以及儒艮和它们的近亲海牛，
都彻底告别了陆地生活，恢复了远祖完全在海洋中生活的习性。

15.en: There are two key fossils called Proganochelys quenstedti and Palaeochersis talampayensis dating from early dinosaur times, which appear to be close to the ancestry of all modern turtles and tortoises.
parts: 有两种关键化石，一种名为 Proganochelys quenstedti，另一种名为 Palaeochersis talampayensis，
都可追溯到恐龙时代早期，似乎与所有现生水龟和陆龟的祖先关系很近。

39.en: In common with all mammals, reptiles and birds, their remote ancestors were marine fish and before that various more or less worm-like creatures stretching back, still in the sea, to the primeval bacteria.
parts: 和所有哺乳动物、爬行动物和鸟类一样，它们的远祖是海鱼。
再往前，是各种多少有些像蠕虫的生物。沿着这条谱系往前追溯，一直到原始细菌，这些祖先始终生活在海里。

4.en: And we mustn’t forget the plants, without whose prior invasion of the land none of the other migrations could have happened.
parts: 还不能忘了植物：要是没有植物率先登上陆地，其他生物就不可能迁到陆地上来。

17.en: Sometimes it’s obvious.
parts: 有时一眼就能看出来。

20.en: With turtles it is a little less obvious.
parts: 到了龟类，情况就稍微没那么明显了。

1.en: Undersea turbines which produce electricity from the tides are set to become an important source of renewable energy for Britain.
parts: 利用潮汐发电的海底涡轮机有望成为英国重要的可再生能源来源。

2.en: It is still too early to predict the extent of the impact they may have, but all the signs are that they will play a significant role in the future
parts: 现在预测这些涡轮机可能产生多大影响还为时过早，但种种迹象都表明，它们将在未来发挥重要作用。

3.en: Operating on the same principle as wind turbines, the power in sea turbines comes from tidal currents which turn blades similar to ships’ propellers, but, unlike wind, the tides are predictable and the power input is constant.
parts: 海底涡轮机与风力涡轮机的工作原理相同。它的动力来自潮流，流动的海水带动形似船舶螺旋桨的叶片旋转。
不过，潮汐与风不同，可以预测，而且输入功率稳定。

4.en: The technology raises the prospect of Britain becoming self-sufficient in renewable energy and drastically reducing its carbon dioxide emissions.
parts: 这项技术使英国有望实现可再生能源自给，并大幅减少二氧化碳排放。

5.en: If tide, wind and wave power are all developed, Britain would be able to close gas, coal and nuclear power plants and export renewable power to other parts of Europe.
parts: 如果潮汐能、风能和波浪能都得到开发，
英国就能关闭燃气、燃煤和核能发电厂，并向欧洲其他地区出口用可再生能源生产的电力。
terms: 用可再生能源生产的电力

6.en: Unlike wind power, which Britain originally developed and then abandoned for 20 years allowing the Dutch to make it a major industry, undersea turbines could become a big export earner to island nations such as Japan and New Zealand.
parts: 风能原本由英国开发，英国后来却将其搁置了二十年，荷兰人由此得以将风能发展为一大产业。
海底涡轮机则可能成为英国面向日本、新西兰等岛国的出口创汇大项。

7.en: Tidal sites have already been identified that will produce one sixth or more of the UK’s power - and at prices competitive with modern gas turbines and undercutting those of the already ailing nuclear industry.
parts: 已经确定了一些潮汐发电场址，这些场址将能提供英国六分之一或更多的电力。
其电价足以与现代燃气轮机发电的价格竞争，且低于本已不景气的核电行业的电价。

8.en: One site alone, the Pentland Firth, between Orkney and mainland Scotland, could produce 10% of the country’s electricity with banks of turbines under the sea, and another at Alderney in the Channel Islands three times the 1,200 megawatts of Britain’s largest and newest nuclear plant, Sizewell B, in Suffolk.
parts: 仅奥克尼群岛与苏格兰本土之间的彭特兰海峡这一处，成排的海底涡轮机就可提供全国10%的电力。
海峡群岛奥尔德尼岛的另一处场址，则可提供相当于萨福克郡塞兹韦尔B核电站三倍的发电功率。后者是英国最大、最新的核电站，功率为1200兆瓦。

12.en: AbuBakr Bahaj, in charge of the Southampton research, said: ‘The prospects for energy from tidal currents are far better than from wind because the flows of water are predictable and constant.
parts: 负责南安普敦这项研究的阿布巴克尔·巴哈吉说：“潮流发电的前景远胜风力发电，
因为水流既可预测又稳定。

13.en: The technology for dealing with the hostile saline environment under the sea has been developed in the North Sea oil industry and much is already known about turbine blade design, because of wind power and ship propellers.
parts: 北海石油工业已经开发出应对海底恶劣盐水环境的技术；
借助风力发电和船舶螺旋桨方面的经验，人们对涡轮叶片的设计也已有了相当多的了解。

17.en: The best sites are between islands or around heavily indented coasts where there are strong tidal currents.
parts: 最佳场址位于岛屿之间，或在海岸线曲折、潮流强劲的沿海地带。

20.en: Unlike wind power, there are unlikely to be environmental objections.
parts: 与风力发电不同，潮汐发电不太可能遭到环保方面的反对。

26.en: One technical difficulty is cavitation, where low pressure behind a turning blade causes air bubbles.
parts: 一个技术难题是空化：旋转叶片背后的压力较低，会形成气泡。

27.en: These can cause vibration and damage the blades of the turbines.
parts: 这些气泡可能引起振动，损坏涡轮机的叶片。

28.en: Dr Bahaj said: ‘We have to test a number of blade types to avoid this happening or at least make sure it does not damage the turbines or reduce performance.
parts: 巴哈吉博士说：“我们得试验多种类型的叶片，以免发生这种情况；
至少也要确保这种现象不会损坏涡轮机或降低其性能。

29.en: Another slight concern is submerged debris floating into the blades.
parts: 另一个小小的顾虑是，水下漂浮的杂物可能漂进叶片之间。

31.en: We will have to make the turbines robust because the sea is a hostile environment, but all the signs that we can do it are good.’
parts: 我们得把涡轮机造得足够坚固，因为海洋环境很恶劣。
不过，目前的种种迹象都表明，我们有望做到这一点。”

9.en: Other sites identified include the Bristol Channel and the west coast of Scotland, particularly the channel between Campbeltown and Northern Ireland.
parts: 其他已经确定的场址包括布里斯托尔海峡和苏格兰西海岸，尤其是坎贝尔敦与北爱尔兰之间的海峡。

10.en: Work on designs for the new turbine blades and sites are well advanced at the University of Southampton’s sustainable energy research group.
parts: 南安普敦大学可持续能源研究小组对新型涡轮叶片和场址的设计工作已取得很大进展。

11.en: The first station is expected to be installed off Lynmouth in Devon shortly to test the technology in a venture jointly funded by the department of Trade and Industry and the European Union.
parts: 首座电站预计不久就会安装在德文郡林茅斯近海，用以测试这项技术。
这一项目由英国贸易与工业部和欧盟共同出资。

14.en: There are a few technical difficulties, but I believe in the next five to ten years we will be installing commercial marine turbine farms.’
parts: 还有几个技术难题，但我相信，在未来五至十年内，我们就会着手建设商业海洋涡轮发电场。”

15.en: Southampton has been awarded £215,000 over three years to develop the turbines and is working with Marine Current Turbines, a subsidiary of IT power, on the Lynmouth project.
parts: 南安普敦大学获得了一笔为期三年、总额21.5万英镑的资助，用于研发涡轮机；
该校正与IT Power旗下的海流涡轮机公司合作，开发林茅斯项目。

16.en: EU research has now identified 106 potential sites for tidal power, 80% round the coasts of Britain.
parts: 欧盟的研究迄今已确定106个潜在的潮汐发电场址，其中80%位于英国沿海。

18.en: A marine turbine blade needs to be only one third of the size of a wind generator to produce three times as much power.
parts: 海洋涡轮机的叶片只需有风力发电机三分之一的大小，就能产生三倍的功率。

19.en: The blades will be about 20 metres in diameter, so around 30 metres of water is required.
parts: 叶片旋转时的直径约为20米，因此所需水深约为30米。

21.en: Fish and other creatures are thought unlikely to be at risk from the relatively slow-turning blades.
parts: 人们认为，这些转动相对缓慢的叶片不太可能危及鱼类和其他生物。

22.en: Each turbine will be mounted on a tower which will connect to the national power supply grid via underwater cables.
parts: 每台涡轮机都将安装在一座塔架上，塔架将经由水下电缆与国家电网相连。

23.en: The towers will stick out of the water and be lit, to warn shipping, and also be designed to be lifted out of the water for maintenance and to clean seaweed from the blades.
parts: 这些塔架将伸出水面，并点灯警示过往船只；
设计上还可将塔架提出水面，以便进行维护，清除叶片上的海藻。

24.en: Dr Bahaj has done most work on the Alderney site, where there are powerful currents.
parts: 巴哈吉博士研究得最多的是奥尔德尼岛的场址，那里的海流很强。

25.en: The single undersea turbine farm would produce far more power than needed for the Channel Islands and most would be fed into the French Grid and be re-imported into Britain via the cable under the Channel.
parts: 单是这一处海底涡轮发电场，发电量就会远超海峡群岛所需；
其中大部分电力将输入法国电网，然后经英吉利海峡底部的电缆重新输入英国。

30.en: So far we do not know how much of a problem it might be.
parts: 目前我们还不知道这可能会带来多大的问题。

1.en: The fact that people go to the Louvre museum in Paris to see the original painting Mona Lisa when they can see a reproduction anywhere leads us to question some assumptions about the role of museums of fine art in today’s world
parts: 人们在任何地方都能看到《蒙娜丽莎》的复制品，却仍然前往巴黎卢浮宫观看原作。
这一事实促使我们重新审视有关美术馆在当今世界所起作用的一些既有看法。

3.en: Nearly everyone who goes to see the original will already be familiar with it from reproductions, but they accept that fine art is more rewardingly viewed in its original form.
parts: 前去看原画的人几乎都已通过复制品熟悉了这幅画，
但他们认同，欣赏美术作品的原作更有收获。

4.en: However, if Mona Lisa was a famous novel, few people would bother to go to a museum to read the writer’s actual manuscript rather than a printed reproduction.
parts: 然而，假如《蒙娜丽莎》是一部著名小说，很少有人会特意跑去博物馆读作家的手稿，而放着印刷本不读。

7.en: With novels, the reader attends mainly to the meaning of words rather than the way they are printed on the page, whereas the ‘reader’ of a painting must attend just as closely to the material form of marks and shapes in the picture as to any ideas they may signify.
parts: 读小说时，读者主要关注的是词语的含义，而非它们印在书页上的样子；
“读”画的人则必须同样仔细地关注两方面：一是画中笔触和形状的具体形态，二是它们可能表达的意思。

8.en: Yet it has always been possible to make very accurate facsimiles of pretty well any fine art work.
parts: 不过，几乎任何美术作品历来都可以仿制得十分逼真。

9.en: The seven surviving versions of Mona Lisa bear witness to the fact that in the 16th century, artists seemed perfectly content to assign the reproduction of their creations to their workshop apprentices as regular ‘bread and butter’ work.
parts: 现存的七个《蒙娜丽莎》版本证明，
在16世纪，画家们似乎很乐意把复制自己作品的活儿交给工作室的学徒，当作他们日常谋生的工作。

10.en: And today the task of reproducing pictures is incomparably more simple and reliable, with reprographic techniques that allow the production of high-quality prints made exactly to the original scale, with faithful colour values, and even with duplication of the surface relief of the painting.
parts: 如今，复制画作的工作简单、可靠得多。图像复制技术可以制作高质量的印刷品，尺寸与原作完全相同，
色彩明暗忠实于原作，甚至连画面表层的凹凸纹理都能复现。

20.en: Evidently, nothing the viewer thinks about the work is going to alter that value, and so today’s viewer is deterred from trying to extend that spontaneous, immediate, self-reliant kind of reading which would originally have met the work.
parts: 显然，观者对作品的任何看法都改变不了这个价值。
因此，如今的观者很难再尝试像作品问世之初的人那样，把自发、直接、凭自身判断的解读继续深入下去。

2.en: One of the most famous works of art in the world is Leonardo da Vinci’s Mona Lisa.
parts: 列奥纳多·达·芬奇的《蒙娜丽莎》是世界上最著名的艺术作品之一。

5.en: This might be explained by the fact that the novel has evolved precisely because of technological developments that made it possible to print out huge numbers of texts, whereas oil paintings have always been produced as unique objects.
parts: 这或许可以用以下事实来解释。小说之所以发展起来，恰恰是因为技术进步使文本可以大量印刷，
而每幅油画从来都是作为独一无二的作品创作出来的。

6.en: In addition, it could be argued that the practice of interpreting or ‘reading’ each medium follows different conventions.
parts: 此外，还可以认为，人们诠释或「阅读」不同艺术媒介时，遵循的惯例也各不相同。

11.en: But despite an implicit recognition that the spread of good reproductions can be culturally valuable, museums continue to promote the special status of original work.
parts: 不过，尽管美术馆也默认传播优质复制品可以有文化价值，它们仍然推崇原作的特殊地位。

12.en: Unfortunately, this seems to place severe limitations on the kind of experience offered to visitors.
parts: 遗憾的是，这似乎大大限制了参观者所能获得的观展体验。

13.en: One limitation is related to the way the museum presents its exhibits.
parts: 其中一项限制与美术馆展示展品的方式有关。

14.en: As repositories of unique historical objects, art museums are often called ‘treasure houses’.
parts: 美术馆收藏着独一无二的历史物件，因此常被称为「宝库」。

15.en: We are reminded of this even before we view a collection by the presence of security guards, attendants, ropes and display cases to keep us away from the exhibits.
parts: 我们甚至还没看见藏品，就已经受到这样的提醒：现场有保安、工作人员、隔离绳和展示柜，让我们与展品保持距离。

16.en: In many cases, the architectural style of the building further reinforces that notion.
parts: 在许多情况下，美术馆建筑本身的风格还会进一步强化这种印象。

17.en: In addition, a major collection like that of London’s National Gallery is housed in numerous rooms, each with dozens of works, any one of which is likely to be worth more than all the average visitor possesses.
parts: 此外，像伦敦国家美术馆这样的大型馆藏，分布在许多展厅里，每个展厅都有数十件作品。
随便哪一件的价值，都很可能超过普通参观者的全部家当。

18.en: In a society that judges the personal status of the individual so much by their material worth, it is therefore difficult not to be impressed by one’s own relative ‘worthlessness’ in such an environment.
parts: 如果一个社会如此看重个人的物质财富，以此评判一个人的社会地位，
那么身处这样的环境，人就很难不深感自己相形之下如此「不值钱」。

19.en: Furthermore, consideration of the ‘Value’ of the original work in its treasure house setting impresses upon the viewer that, since these works were originally produced, they have been assigned a huge monetary value by some person or institution more powerful than themselves.
parts: 再者，在这样的「宝库」中思量原作的「价值」，观者会清楚地意识到，
自这些作品问世以来，已有比观者自己更有权势的个人或机构给它们定下了极高的金钱价值。

21.en: The visitor may then be struck by the strangeness of seeing such diverse paintings, drawings and sculptures brought together in an environment for which they were not originally created.
parts: 随后，参观者可能会觉得奇怪：如此多样的绘画、素描和雕塑作品被放在一起，
而艺术家最初创作这些作品时，并非要将它们置于这样的环境中。

22.en: This ‘displacement effect’ is further heightened by the sheer volume of exhibits.
parts: 单是展品数量之多，就进一步加剧了这种「错置效应」。

23.en: In the case of a major collection, there are probably more works on display than we could realistically view in weeks or even months.
parts: 就大型馆藏而言，展出的作品很可能多到我们即使花上数周甚至数月，实际上也看不完。

24.en: This is particularly distressing because time seems to be a vital factor in the appreciation of all art forms.
parts: 这一点尤其令人苦恼，因为在欣赏各种艺术形式时，时间似乎都是至关重要的因素。

25.en: A fundamental difference between paintings and other art forms is that there is no prescribed time over which a painting is viewed.
parts: 绘画与其他艺术形式的一个根本区别在于，观看一幅画要花多长时间，并无规定。

26.en: By contrast, the audience encounters an opera or a play over a specific time, which is the duration of the performance.
parts: 相比之下，观众欣赏歌剧或戏剧要经历一段固定的时间，就是演出本身的时长。

27.en: Similarly, novels and poems are read in a prescribed temporal sequence, whereas a picture has no clear place at which to start viewing or at which to finish.
parts: 同样，读小说和诗歌有既定的先后顺序，
看一幅画却没有明确的起点或终点。

28.en: Thus art works themselves encourage us to view them superficially, without appreciating the richness of detail and labour that is involved.
parts: 因此，艺术品本身也使我们容易看得浮光掠影，体会不到作品中丰富的细节以及投入其中的心血。

29.en: Consequently, the dominant critical approach becomes that of the art historian, a specialised academic approach devoted to ‘discovering the meaning’ of art within the cultural context of its time.
parts: 这样一来，占主导地位的艺术评论方式便成了艺术史学家的做法：
采用专门的学术方法，在艺术作品所属时代的文化背景中「发掘其意义」。

30.en: This is in perfect harmony with the museum’s function, since the approach is dedicated to seeking out and conserving ‘authentic’, ‘original’ readings of the exhibits.
parts: 这与美术馆的职能完全一致，因为这种方法致力于探寻并保存对展品「真实的」「原初的」解读。

31.en: Again, this seems to put paid to that spontaneous, participatory criticism which can be found in abundance in criticism of classic works of literature, but is absent from most art history.
parts: 这似乎也让那种自发、参与式的评论无从开展。
这样的评论在对经典文学作品的评论中随处可见，大多数艺术史论述中却看不到。

32.en: The displays of art museums serve as a warning of what critical practices can emerge when spontaneous criticism is suppressed.
parts: 美术馆的陈列方式给了我们一个警示：当自发的评论受到压制时，会出现怎样的艺术评论方式。

33.en: The museum public, like any other audience, experience art more rewardingly when given the confidence to express their views.
parts: 和其他观众一样，当美术馆的参观者有信心表达自己的看法时，欣赏艺术也会更有收获。

34.en: If appropriate works of fine art could be rendered permanently accessible to the public by means of high-fidelity reproductions, as literature and music already are, the public may feel somewhat less in awe of them.
parts: 如果能通过高度逼真的复制品，让公众像接触文学和音乐一样，随时都能接触到适合这样呈现的美术作品，
那么公众对这些作品的敬畏之心或许会稍减一些。

35.en: Unfortunately, that may be too much to ask from those who seek to maintain and control the art establishment.
parts: 遗憾的是，对于那些想要维持并掌控美术界现有体制的人来说，这个要求也许过高了。

5.en: For Robert B. Cialdini, Professor of Psychology at Arizona State University, one reason that companies don’t succeed as often as they should is that innovation starts with recruitment.
parts: 在亚利桑那州立大学心理学教授罗伯特·B. 西奥迪尼看来，企业成功的次数没有应有的那么多，其中一个原因是创新始于招聘。

6.en: Research shows that the fit between an employee’s values and a company’s values makes a difference to what contribution they make and whether, two years after they join, they’re still at the company.
parts: 研究表明，员工个人价值观与公司价值观的契合程度，会影响员工能作出怎样的贡献，
也会影响他们入职两年后是否仍在这家公司工作。

27.en: ‘When asked how they had cracked the code ahead of an array of highly accomplished rival investigators, he said something that stunned me.
parts: “有人问他，他们是怎样赶在众多成就斐然的同行之前解开这个谜的。
他的一句话让我大吃一惊。

28.en: He said he and Crick had succeeded because they were aware that they weren’t the most intelligent of the scientists pursuing the answer.
parts: 他说，他和克里克之所以成功，是因为他们清楚，在那些探寻答案的科学家中，他们并非最聪明的。

29.en: The smartest scientist was called Rosalind Franklin who, Watson said, “was so intelligent she rarely sought advice”.’
parts: 最聪明的那位科学家名叫罗莎琳德·富兰克林。沃森说，她‘聪明得很少向人请教’。”

16.en: Managers should therefore adopt an approach that appears counter-intuitive — they should explain what stands to be lost if the company fails to seize a particular opportunity.
parts: 因此，管理者应采用一种看似有悖直觉的做法：
他们应说明，如果公司没能抓住某个特定机会，可能会失去什么。

1.en: Why are so few companies truly innovative?
parts: 真正具有创新能力的企业为什么这么少？

2.en: Innovation is key to business survival, and companies put substantial resources into inspiring employees to develop new ideas.
parts: 创新是企业生存的关键。为了激发员工提出新想法，企业投入了大量资源。

3.en: There are, nevertheless, people working in luxurious, state-of-the-art centres designed to stimulate innovation who find that their environment doesn’t make them feel at all creative.
parts: 然而，有些人在豪华而先进、专为激发创新而设计的中心工作，
却觉得这样的环境丝毫不能让自己产生创造的感觉。

4.en: And there are those who don’t have a budget, or much space, but who innovate successfully.
parts: 也有人既没有预算，也没有多少空间，却能成功创新。

7.en: Studies at Harvard Business School show that, although some individuals may be more creative than others, almost every individual can be creative in the right circumstances.
parts: 哈佛商学院的研究表明，有些人也许比别人更有创造力，但在合适的条件下，几乎人人都可以发挥创造力。

8.en: One of the most famous photographs in the story of rock’n’roll emphasises Cialdini’s views.
parts: 摇滚乐史上最著名的照片之一，凸显了西奥迪尼的看法。

9.en: The 1956 picture of singers Elvis Presley, Carl Perkins, Johnny Cash and Jerry Lee Lewis jamming at a piano in Sun Studios in Memphis tells a hidden story.
parts: 1956年的这张照片拍下了歌手埃尔维斯·普雷斯利、卡尔·珀金斯、约翰尼·卡什和杰瑞·李·刘易斯
在孟菲斯的太阳录音室围着钢琴即兴合奏的情景。照片背后还有一个鲜为人知的故事。

10.en: Sun’s ‘million-dollar quartet’ could have been a quintet.
parts: 太阳唱片的“百万美元四重奏”本来可以是五重奏。

11.en: Missing from the picture is Roy Orbison, a greater natural singer than Lewis, Perkins or Cash.
parts: 照片里少了罗伊·奥比森。论唱歌的天赋，他比刘易斯、珀金斯或卡什都要出色。

12.en: Sam Phillips, who owned Sun, wanted to revolutionise popular music with songs that fused black and white music, and country and blues.
parts: 太阳唱片老板萨姆·菲利普斯想革新流行音乐。他希望让歌曲融合黑人音乐和白人音乐，也融合乡村音乐和布鲁斯音乐。

13.en: Presley, Cash, Perkins and Lewis instinctively understood Phillips’s ambition and believed in it.
parts: 普雷斯利、卡什、珀金斯和刘易斯凭直觉就理解了菲利普斯的抱负，也认同这个目标。

14.en: Orbison wasn’t inspired by the goal, and only ever achieved one hit with the Sun label.
parts: 这个目标没有打动奥比森，他在太阳唱片旗下只出过一首热门歌曲。

15.en: The value fit matters, says Cialdini, because innovation is, in part, a process of change, and under that pressure we, as a species, behave differently, ‘When things change, we are hard-wired to play it safe.’
parts: 西奥迪尼说，价值观是否契合很重要，因为创新在一定程度上是一个变革的过程，而人类在这种压力下会表现得不同。
“事情发生变化时，我们天生就倾向于求稳。”

17.en: Studies show that we invariably take more gambles when threatened with a loss than when offered a reward.
parts: 研究表明，与有机会得到奖励时相比，面临损失的威胁时，我们总会更愿意冒险。

18.en: Managing innovation is a delicate art.
parts: 管理创新是一门需要拿捏分寸的艺术。

19.en: It’s easy for a company to be pulled in conflicting directions as the marketing, product development, and finance departments each get different feedback from different sets of people.
parts: 一家企业很容易被拉向相互冲突的方向，
因为市场营销、产品开发和财务部门各自从不同的人群那里得到不同的反馈。

20.en: And without a system which ensures collaborative exchanges within the company, it’s also easy for small ‘pockets of innovation’ to disappear.
parts: 如果缺少能保障企业内部协作交流的机制，零星出现的创新也很容易消失。

21.en: Innovation is a contact sport.
parts: 创新就像一项需要身体接触的运动。

22.en: You can’t brief people just by saying, ‘We’re going in this direction and I’m going to take you with me.’
parts: 要向大家交代清楚事情，光说“我们要朝这个方向走，我会带你们一起走”可不够。

23.en: Cialdini believes that this ‘follow-the-leader syndrome’ is dangerous, not least because it encourages bosses to go it alone.
parts: 西奥迪尼认为，这种“盲从领导”的倾向很危险，一个重要原因在于它会助长老板独断独行。

24.en: ‘It’s been scientifically proven that three people will be better than one at solving problems, even if that one person is the smartest person in the field.’
parts: “科学研究已经证明，解决问题时三个人会胜过一个人，即便那个人是该领域最聪明的人。”

25.en: To prove his point, Cialdini cites an interview with molecular biologist James Watson.
parts: 为证明自己的观点，西奥迪尼引用了一次对分子生物学家詹姆斯·沃森的采访。

26.en: Watson, together with Francis Crick, discovered the structure of DNA, the genetic information carrier of all living organisms.
parts: 沃森与弗朗西斯·克里克共同发现了DNA的结构。DNA是所有生物体遗传信息的载体。

30.en: Teamwork taps into one of the basic drivers of human behaviour.
parts: 团队合作借助了人类行为的一种基本驱动力。

31.en: ‘The principle of social proof is so pervasive that we don’t even recognise it,’ says Cialdini.
parts: 西奥迪尼说：“从众认同原则无处不在，我们甚至意识不到它的存在。”

32.en: ‘If your project is being resisted, for example, by a group of veteran employees, ask another old-timer to speak up for it.’
parts: “比如，如果你的项目受到一群资深员工的抵制，就请另一位老员工站出来表示支持。”

33.en: Cialdini is not alone in advocating this strategy.
parts: 主张这一策略的人并非只有西奥迪尼。

34.en: Research shows that peer power, used horizontally not vertically, is much more powerful than any boss’s speech.
parts: 研究表明，让同事之间横向发挥影响力，而非依靠上下级的纵向影响，比任何老板发表讲话都更有力量。

35.en: Writing, visualising and prototyping can stimulate the flow of new ideas.
parts: 把想法写下来、用图像呈现出来、制成原型，这些做法都能促使新点子不断涌现。

36.en: Cialdini cites scores of research papers and historical events that prove that even something as simple as writing deepens every individual’s engagement in the project.
parts: 西奥迪尼举出了大量研究论文和历史事件，
用以证明，即使是像写下来这样简单的事，也能让每个人更加投入项目。

37.en: It is, he says, the reason why all those competitions on breakfast cereal packets encouraged us to write in saying, in no more than 10 words: ‘I like Kellogg’s Corn Flakes because….’
parts: 他说，这就解释了为什么那些印在早餐麦片包装上的有奖竞赛都鼓励我们来信，
用不超过十个词续写“我喜欢家乐氏玉米片，因为……”这句话。

38.en: The very act of writing makes us more likely to believe it.
parts: 单是把这句话写下来，就会让我们更容易相信它。

39.en: Authority doesn’t have to inhibit innovation but it often does.
parts: 权威未必会抑制创新，但它常常确实起了这样的作用。

40.en: The wrong kind of leadership will lead to what Cialdini calls ‘captainitis, the regrettable tendency of team members to opt out of team responsibilities that are properly theirs’.
parts: 不当的领导方式会导致西奥迪尼所说的“机长病”，
也就是团队成员往往会推卸本该由自己承担的团队责任，令人惋惜。

41.en: He calls it captainitis because, he says, ‘crew members of multipilot aircraft exhibit a sometimes deadly passivity when the flight captain makes a clearly wrong-headed decision’.
parts: 他称这种现象为“机长病”，因为用他的话说，
“在由多名飞行员共同驾驶的飞机上，如果机长作出了明显错误的决定，机组人员会消极服从，有时甚至会酿成致命后果。”
terms: 由多名飞行员共同驾驶的飞机

42.en: This behaviour is not, he says, unique to air travel, but can happen in any workplace where the leader is overbearing.
parts: 他说，这种行为并非航空业所独有。只要领导者专横，任何工作场所都可能出现这种情况。

43.en: At the other end of the scale is the 1980s Memphis design collective, a group of young designers for whom ‘the only rule was that there were no rules’.
parts: 另一个极端是20世纪80年代的孟菲斯设计团体。对这群年轻设计师而言，“唯一的规则就是没有规则”。
terms: at the other end of the scale
at the other end of the scale

44.en: This environment encouraged a free interchange of ideas, which led to more creativity with form, function, colour and materials that revolutionised attitudes to furniture design.
parts: 这样的环境鼓励人们自由交流想法，使他们在造型、功能、色彩和材料上更有创造力，也彻底改变了人们对家具设计的看法。

45.en: Many theorists believe the ideal boss should lead from behind, taking pride in collective accomplishment and giving credit where it is due.
parts: 许多理论家认为，理想的老板应在幕后引导团队，以集体的成就为荣，并把功劳归给应得的人。
terms: giving credit where it is due
give credit where it is due

46.en: Cialdini says: ‘Leaders should encourage everyone to contribute and simultaneously assure all concerned that every recommendation is important to making the right decision and will be given full attention.’
parts: 西奥迪尼说：“领导者应鼓励每个人献计献策，同时向所有相关人员保证，
每一项建议对于作出正确决定都很重要，也都会得到充分重视。”

47.en: The frustrating thing about innovation is that there are many approaches, but no magic formula.
parts: 创新令人沮丧之处在于，方法虽多，却没有什么万能公式。

48.en: However, a manager who wants to create a truly innovative culture can make their job a lot easier by recognising these psychological realities.
parts: 不过，想要营造真正创新文化的管理者，如果能认识到这些心理事实，工作就会轻松得多。

3.en: In April 2002 an event took place which demonstrated one of the many applications of information theory.
parts: 2002年4月发生的一件事，展示了信息论众多用途中的一种。

17.en: This all seems light years away from the down-to-earth uses Shannon originally had for his work, which began when he was a 22-year-old graduate engineering student at the prestigious Massachusetts Institute of Technology in 1939.
parts: 这一切似乎与香农最初为这项研究设想的实际用途相去甚远。
这项研究始于1939年，当时22岁的香农是著名的麻省理工学院的一名工程学研究生。

31.en: As recently as 1993, engineers made a major breakthrough by discovering so-called turbo codes - which come very close to Shannon’s ultimate limit for the maximum rate that data can be transmitted reliably, and now play a key role in the mobile videophone revolution.
parts: 就在1993年，工程师们发现了所谓的涡轮码，取得了一项重大突破。
使用这种编码时，数据可靠传输的速率非常接近香农所确定的理论上限。
如今，这种编码在移动视频通话技术的革新中发挥着关键作用。

28.en: Over the years scientists have devised many such coding methods, and they have proved crucial in many technological feats.
parts: 多年来，科学家们设计了许多这样的编码方法。这些方法在许多技术壮举中都起到了关键作用。

29.en: The Voyager spacecraft transmitted data using codes which added one extra bit for every single bit of information; the result was an error rate of just one bit in 10,000 - and stunningly clear pictures of the planets.
parts: 旅行者号航天器用编码传输数据，每传输一比特信息，就额外加上一比特。
结果，每一万比特中仅有一比特出错，传回的行星图像也清晰得惊人。

30.en: Other codes have become part of everyday life - such as the Universal Product Code, or bar code, which uses a simple error-detecting system that ensures supermarket check-out lasers can read the price even on, say, a crumpled bag of crisps.
parts: 另一些编码已成为日常生活的一部分，例如通用产品代码，也称条形码。
它采用简单的检错系统，即使是一袋包装皱巴巴的薯片，超市收银台的激光扫描器也能读出价格。

32.en: Shannon also laid the foundations of more efficient ways of storing information, by stripping out superfluous (‘redundant’) bits from data which contributed little real information.
parts: 香农还为更高效的信息存储方法奠定了基础。他的做法是从数据中剔除多余的（即“冗余的”）比特，因为这些比特几乎没有提供什么实际信息。

33.en: As mobile phone text messages like ‘I CN C U’ show, it is often possible to leave out a lot of data without losing much meaning.
parts: 正如用“I CN C U”来表示“我能看见你”这样的手机短信所示，省去大量数据，往往也不会损失多少含义。

34.en: As with error correction, however, there’s a limit beyond which messages become too ambiguous.
parts: 不过，和纠错一样，信息压缩也有个限度。一旦超过这个限度，信息的含义就会过于模糊。

35.en: Shannon showed how to calculate this limit, opening the way to the design of compression methods that cram maximum information into the minimum space.
parts: 香农说明了如何计算这个极限，为设计出能用最小空间容纳最多信息的压缩方法铺平了道路。

13.en: But it also highlighted the astonishing power of the techniques developed by American communications engineer Claude Shannon, who had died just a year earlier.
parts: 但这件事也凸显了美国通信工程师克劳德·香农所开发的技术具有何等惊人的力量。就在一年前，香农去世了。

16.en: In the 1940s, he single-handedly created an entire science of communication which has since inveigled its way into a host of applications, from DVDs to satellite communications to bar codes - any area, in short, where data has to be conveyed rapidly yet accurately.
parts: 20世纪40年代，他独力创立了一整门通信科学。
从那以后，这门科学逐渐渗透到众多应用之中，从DVD到卫星通信，再到条形码。
简而言之，凡是需要迅速而又准确地传递数据的领域，都用得上它。

26.en: The resulting limit, given in units of bits per second, is the absolute maximum rate of error-free communication given signal strength and noise level.
parts: 由此得出的极限以比特每秒为单位。
在信号强度和噪声水平给定的条件下，它就是无差错通信所能达到的最高速率。

27.en: The trick, Shannon showed, is to find ways of packaging up – ‘coding’, - information to cope with the ravages of noise, while staying within the information-carrying capacity -’bandwidth’ - of the communication system being used.
parts: 香农指出，诀窍在于想办法把信息打包，即对信息进行编码，以应对噪声的破坏。
同时，信息量要控制在所用通信系统的信息承载能力之内，也就是不能超过它的带宽。

5.en: Megafires, also called ‘siege fires’, are the increasingly frequent blazes that burn 500,000 acres or more - 10 times the size of the average forest fire of 20 years ago.
parts: 特大野火也叫“围困式大火”。这种火灾越来越频繁，每场烧过的面积达50万英亩或更多，
是20年前一场森林火灾平均过火面积的十倍。

3.en: There’s a reason fire squads battling more frequent blazes in Southern California are having such difficulty containing the flames, despite better preparedness than ever and decades of experience fighting fires fanned by the ‘Santa Ana Winds’.
parts: 南加州的消防队面对越来越频繁的大火，如此难以控制火势是有原因的，
尽管他们准备得比以往任何时候都充分，也有数十年扑救圣安娜风助长的大火的经验。

19.en: That said, many experts give California high marks for making progress on preparedness in recent years, after some of the largest fires in state history scorched thousands of acres, burned thousands of homes, and killed numerous people.
parts: 话虽如此，许多专家仍对加州近年来在防火准备方面取得的进展给予高度评价。
在此之前，加州经历了该州有史以来规模最大的几场火灾，数千英亩土地被烧焦，数千栋住宅被烧毁，还有许多人丧生。

20.en: Stung in the past by criticism of bungling that allowed fires to spread when they might have been contained, personnel are meeting the peculiar challenges of neighborhood—and canyon—hopping fires better than previously, observers say.
parts: 消防人员过去曾因处置失当，让本有可能得到控制的火势蔓延而饱受批评。
据观察人士说，如今他们应对火势跨越社区和峡谷蔓延所带来的特殊挑战，比过去做得更好。

22.en: Firefighters’ unions that in the past complained of dilapidated equipment, old fire engines, and insufficient blueprints for fire safety are now praising the state’s commitment, noting that funding for firefighting has increased, despite huge cuts in many other programs.
parts: 消防员工会过去曾抱怨装备破旧、消防车老化，消防安全规划也不够完善，
如今却称赞州政府对消防工作的重视。他们指出，尽管许多其他项目的经费大幅削减，消防经费却增加了。

27.en: There is a sense among both government officials and residents that the speed, dedication, and coordination of firefighters from several states and jurisdictions are resulting in greater efficiency than in past ‘siege fire’ situations.
parts: 政府官员和居民都有这样一种感受：
来自多个州和辖区的消防员行动迅速、尽职尽责、配合默契，因此比过去应对“围困式大火”时更有效率。

28.en: In recent years, the Southern California region has improved building codes, evacuation procedures, and procurement of new technology.
parts: 近年来，南加州改进了建筑规范、疏散程序和新技术的采购方式。

29.en: ‘I am extraordinarily impressed by the improvements we have witnessed,’ says Randy Jacobs, a Southern California-based lawyer who has had to evacuate both his home and business to escape wildfires.
parts: “我们亲眼看到的这些改进，给我留下了极其深刻的印象。”
在南加州执业的律师兰迪·雅各布斯说。为了躲避野火，他曾不得不从住所和工作场所撤离。

30.en: ‘Notwithstanding all the damage that will continue to be caused by wildfires, we will no longer suffer the loss of life endured in the past because of the fire prevention and firefighting measures that have been put in place,’ he says.
parts: “尽管野火仍将造成种种损失，
我们再也不会像过去那样有人丧生了，因为各项防火和灭火措施已经落实。”他说。

14.en: ‘We are increasingly building our homes in fire-prone ecosystems,’ says Dominik Kulakowski, adjunct professor of biology at Clark University Graduate School of Geography in Worcester, Massachusetts.
parts: “我们越来越常在火灾易发的生态系统中建房，”多米尼克·库拉科夫斯基说。
他是马萨诸塞州伍斯特市克拉克大学地理研究生院的生物学兼职教授。
names: 多米尼克·库拉科夫斯基

24.en: Besides providing money to upgrade the fire engines that must traverse the mammoth state and wind along serpentine canyon roads, the state has invested in better command-and-control facilities as well as in the strategies to run them.
parts: 除了拨款升级消防车——
这些车辆必须穿越幅员辽阔的加州，沿蜿蜒的峡谷道路行驶——
州政府还投资改善指挥与控制设施，并为这些设施的运行方案投入了资金。

15.en: ‘Doing that in many of the forests of the western US is like building homes on the side of an active volcano.’
parts: “在美国西部的许多森林里这样做，就像在活火山的山坡上建房子。”

16.en: In California, where population growth has averaged more than 600,000 a year for at least a decade, more residential housing is being built.
parts: 加利福尼亚州至少在过去十年里，人口平均每年增长超过60万。如今那里正在兴建更多住宅。

23.en: ‘We are pleased that the current state administration has been very proactive in its support of us, and [has] come through with budgetary support of the infrastructure needs we have long sought,’ says Mr. McHale of the firefighters’ union.
parts: “我们很高兴，现任州政府一直非常主动地支持我们，
而且确实为我们长期争取的基础设施需求提供了预算支持。”消防员工会的麦克黑尔先生说。

26.en: After a commission examined and revamped communications procedures, the statewide response ‘has become far more professional and responsive,’ he says.
parts: 一个委员会审查并改进了通信流程。
此后，据他说，全州应对火灾“专业得多，响应也快得多了”。

10.en: ‘All these factors must have been necessary but not sufficient to cause the revolution,’ says Macfarlane.
parts: 麦克法兰说：“这些因素一定都是促成这场革命的必要条件，但还不是充分条件。”

6.en: Macfarlane compares the puzzle to a combination lock.
parts: 麦克法兰把这个谜题比作一把密码锁。

7.en: ‘There are about 20 different factors and all of them need to be present before the revolution can happen,’ he says.
parts: 他说：“大约有二十个不同的因素，必须全部具备，这场革命才有可能发生。”

8.en: For industry to take off, there needs to be the technology and power to drive factories, large urban populations to provide cheap labour, easy transport to move goods around, an affluent middle-class willing to buy mass-produced objects, a market-driven economy and a political system that allows this to happen.
parts: 工业要腾飞，需要能让工厂运转的技术和动力，能提供廉价劳动力的庞大城市人口，
便于运输货物的交通，愿意购买大批量生产的商品的富裕中产阶级，
还需要市场驱动的经济和容许这一切发生的政治体制。

16.en: The theory sounds eccentric but once he starts to explain the detective work that went into his deduction, the scepticism gives way to wary admiration.
parts: 这个理论听起来有些古怪，但他一开始解释自己是怎样像侦探一样调查、得出这个结论的，怀疑便逐渐变成了带有几分保留的钦佩。

36.en: ‘When you start moving towards an industrial revolution, it is economically efficient to have people living close together,’ says Macfarlane.
parts: 麦克法兰说：“社会开始迈向工业革命时，人们集中居住在经济上更有效率。”

55.en: Macfarlane notes that even though 17th-century Japan had large cities, high literacy rates, even a futures market, it had turned its back on the essence of any work-based revolution by giving up labour-saving devices such as animals, afraid that they would put people out of work.
parts: 麦克法兰指出，尽管十七世纪的日本有大城市、很高的识字率，甚至还有期货市场，
它却背离了任何生产变革的要义。日本放弃了畜力等节省劳力的手段，担心这些手段会让人失业。

15.en: The antiseptic properties of tannin, the active ingredient in tea, and of hops in beer - plus the fact that both are made with boiled water - allowed urban communities to flourish at close quarters without succumbing to water-borne diseases such as dysentery.
parts: 茶中的活性成分单宁和啤酒花都具有杀菌作用，
再加上茶和啤酒都用煮沸的水制成，
因此城市居民即使生活得很密集，也能繁衍兴盛，免受痢疾等水传播疾病的侵袭。

52.en: Macfarlane guessed that the fact that water had to be boiled, together with the stomach-purifying properties of tea meant that the breast milk provided by mothers was healthier than it had ever been.
parts: 麦克法兰猜测，泡茶须把水烧开，加上茶具有清洁肠胃的作用，
这使得母亲的乳汁比以往任何时候都更健康。

1.en: A Cambridge professor says that a change in drinking habits was the reason for the Industrial Revolution in Britain.
parts: 一位剑桥大学教授认为，英国工业革命的起因是人们饮用习惯的改变。

2.en: Anjana Ahuja reports
parts: 安贾娜·阿胡贾报道。

3.en: Alan Macfarlane, professor of anthropological science at Kings College, Cambridge, has, like other historians, spent decades wrestling with the enigma of the Industrial Revolution.
parts: 剑桥大学国王学院人类学教授艾伦·麦克法兰和其他历史学家一样，花了几十年试图解开工业革命之谜。

4.en: Why did this particular Big Bang - the world-changing birth of industry - happen in Britain?
parts: 为什么这场改变世界的“大爆炸”——工业的兴起——偏偏发生在英国？
terms: 特定的；指这里说的那一次

5.en: And why did it strike at the end of the 18th century?
parts: 它又为什么偏偏发生在18世纪末？

9.en: While this was the case for England, other nations, such as Japan, the Netherlands and France also met some of these criteria but were not industrialising.
parts: 英格兰确实具备这些条件。日本、荷兰和法国等其他国家也符合其中一些条件，却并没有走上工业化道路。

11.en: ‘After all, Holland had everything except coal, while China also had many of these factors.
parts: “毕竟，除了煤，荷兰具备其他所有条件；中国也具备其中许多条件。

12.en: Most historians are convinced there are one or two missing factors that you need to open the lock.’
parts: 大多数历史学家都确信，还缺一两个打开这把锁所必需的因素。”

13.en: The missing factors, he proposes, are to be found in almost every kitchen cupboard.
parts: 他提出，几乎每家的厨房橱柜里都能找到这些缺失的因素。

14.en: Tea and beer, two of the nation’s favourite drinks, fuelled the revolution.
parts: 茶和啤酒是英国人最喜爱的饮品中的两种，正是它们推动了这场革命。

17.en: Macfarlane’s case has been strengthened by support from notable quarters - Roy Porter, the distinguished medical historian, recently wrote a favourable appraisal of his research.
parts: 麦克法兰的论点得到知名人士支持，说服力更强了。著名医学史学家罗伊·波特最近就撰文肯定了他的研究。
terms: 知名人士或有影响力的方面

18.en: Macfarlane had wondered for a long time how the Industrial Revolution came about.
parts: 工业革命是怎样发生的？这个问题麦克法兰已经思考了很久。

19.en: Historians had alighted on one interesting factor around the mid-18th century that required explanation.
parts: 历史学家们注意到，约在18世纪中叶出现了一个值得解释的现象。

20.en: Between about 1650 and 1740, the population in Britain was static.
parts: 约从1650年到1740年，英国人口一直没有变化。

21.en: But then there was a burst in population growth.
parts: 但随后，人口突然迅速增长。

22.en: Macfarlane says: ‘The infant mortality rate halved in the space of 20 years, and this happened in both rural areas and cities, and across all classes.
parts: 麦克法兰说：“短短20年内，婴儿死亡率就降了一半，农村和城市都如此，各个社会阶层也都如此。

23.en: People suggested four possible causes.
parts: 人们提出了四种可能的原因。

24.en: Was there a sudden change in the viruses and bacteria around?
parts: 是不是周围的病毒和细菌突然发生了变化？

26.en: Was there a revolution in medical science?
parts: 会不会是医学发生了革命性的进展？

27.en: But this was a century before Lister’s revolution.
parts: 可这比李斯特带来的医学变革还早一个世纪。

28.en: Was there a change in environmental conditions?
parts: 是环境条件发生了变化吗？

29.en: There were improvements in agriculture that wiped out malaria, but these were small gains.
parts: 农业方面的改进确实消除了疟疾，但这些成效有限。

30.en: Sanitation did not become widespread until the 19th century.
parts: 直到19世纪，公共卫生设施才普及。

31.en: The only option left is food.
parts: 这样一来，剩下唯一可能的解释就是食物了。

32.en: But the height and weight statistics show a decline.
parts: 可是统计数据显示，人们的身高和体重都下降了。

33.en: So the food must have got worse.
parts: 所以饮食状况一定是变差了。
terms: 一定曾经（对过去的推断）

34.en: Efforts to explain this sudden reduction in child deaths appeared to draw a blank.’
parts: 看来，人们试图解释儿童死亡人数为何骤减，却一无所获。”

35.en: This population burst seemed to happen at just the right time to provide labour for the Industrial Revolution.
parts: 这次人口激增似乎来得正是时候，恰好为工业革命提供了劳动力。

37.en: ‘But then you get disease, particularly from human waste.’
parts: “可这样一来，疾病就会随之而来，尤其是人类排泄物引起的疾病。”

38.en: Some digging around in historical records revealed that there was a change in the incidence of water-borne disease at that time, especially dysentery.
parts: 查阅史料发现，当时经水传播的疾病发病率有所变化，痢疾尤其如此。

39.en: Macfarlane deduced that whatever the British were drinking must have been important in regulating disease.
parts: 麦克法兰由此推断，不管当时英国人喝的是什么，他们喝的东西一定对控制疾病起了重要作用。

40.en: He says, ‘We drank beer.
parts: 他说：“我们当时喝的是啤酒。

41.en: For a long time, the English were protected by the strong antibacterial agent in hops, which were added to help preserve the beer.
parts: 长期以来，英国人得到了啤酒花中强效抗菌成分的保护。人们在啤酒中加入啤酒花，是为了使酒更耐保存。

42.en: But in the late 17th century a tax was introduced on malt, the basic ingredient of beer.
parts: 但是到了17世纪末，酿造啤酒的基本原料麦芽开始被征税。

43.en: The poor turned to water and gin and in the 1720s the mortality rate began to rise again.
parts: 穷人转而喝水和杜松子酒，到了18世纪20年代，死亡率又开始上升。
可随后死亡率又突然降了下来。
这又是什么原因造成的呢？”

46.en: Macfarlane looked to Japan, which was also developing large cities about the same time, and also had no sanitation.
parts: 麦克法兰把目光转向日本。大约在同一时期，日本也开始发展大城市，同样缺乏公共卫生设施。

47.en: Water-borne diseases had a much looser grip on the Japanese population than those in Britain.
parts: 经水传播的疾病对日本人口的影响，比对英国人口的影响小得多。

48.en: Could it be the prevalence of tea in their culture?
parts: 会不会是因为饮茶在日本文化中十分普遍？

49.en: Macfarlane then noted that the history of tea in Britain provided an extraordinary coincidence of dates.
parts: 麦克法兰随后注意到，英国饮茶史上的一个时间点与此惊人地吻合。

50.en: Tea was relatively expensive until Britain started a direct clipper trade with China in the early 18th century.
parts: 茶原本比较昂贵，直到18世纪初英国开始用快速帆船与中国直接通商。

51.en: By the 1740s, about the time that infant mortality was dipping, the drink was common.
parts: 到18世纪40年代，饮茶已很普遍，而这恰好也是婴儿死亡率下降的时候。

53.en: No other European nation sipped tea like the British, which, by Macfarlane’s logic, pushed these other countries out of contention for the revolution.
parts: 其他欧洲国家都不像英国人那样喝茶。按麦克法兰的逻辑，这使那些国家失去了率先发生工业革命的可能。

54.en: But, if tea is a factor in the combination lock, why didn’t Japan forge ahead in a tea-soaked industrial revolution of its own?
parts: 不过，如果茶是打开这把密码锁的一个条件，为什么同样盛行饮茶的日本没有趁势掀起自己的工业革命呢？
terms: 茶味浓厚的（喻饮茶盛行）

56.en: So, the nation that we now think of as one of the most technologically advanced entered the 19th century having ‘abandoned the wheel’.
parts: 就这样，我们如今视为技术最先进的国家之一，在进入19世纪时却已“弃车轮而不用”。

1.en: Internationally, ‘giftedness’ is most frequently determined by a score on a general intelligence test, known as an IQ test, which is above a chosen cut-off point, usually at around the top 2-5%.
parts: 在世界各地，最常见的“天赋”判定方法，是看一个人在一般智力测验（即智商测验）中的得分是否超过选定的分界值。
这条分界线通常划在得分最高的约2%至5%的人群处。

2.en: Children’s educational environment contributes to the IQ score and the way intelligence is used.
parts: 儿童的教育环境会影响他们的智商得分，也会影响他们运用智力的方式。

4.en: The higher the children’s IQ scores, especially over IQ 130, the better the quality of their educational backup, measured in terms of reported verbal interactions with parents, number of books and activities in their home etc.
parts: 孩子的智商得分越高，尤其是超过130时，他们得到的教育支持质量也越高。
衡量这种支持的指标包括据报孩子与父母的言语交流、家里的藏书和活动数量等。

5.en: Because IQ tests are decidedly influenced by what the child has learned, they are to some extent measures of current achievement based on age-norms; that is, how well the children have learned to manipulate their knowledge and know-how within the terms of the test.
parts: 由于智商测验显然受到孩子所学内容的影响，这类测验在一定程度上衡量的是孩子相对于其年龄常模的当前学习成果。
也就是说，它衡量孩子学会在测验规定的范围内运用知识和技能的程度。

9.en: To reach an exceptionally high standard in any area very able children need the means to learn, which includes material to work with and focused challenging tuition - and the encouragement to follow their dream.
parts: 要在任何一个领域达到格外高的水准，能力出众的孩子都需要相应的学习条件。
这些条件包括可供使用的材料、有针对性且富有挑战性的指导，以及鼓励他们追求梦想的支持。

10.en: There appears to be a qualitative difference in the way the intellectually highly able think, compared with more average-ability or older pupils, for whom external regulation by the teacher often compensates for lack of internal regulation.
parts: 与能力较为普通或年龄较大的学生相比，智力出众的学生在思维方式上似乎有质的差异。
对于那些能力较为普通或年龄较大的学生，教师的外部调节往往能弥补他们自我调节的不足。

11.en: To be at their most effective in their self-regulation, all children can be helped to identify their own ways of learning - metacognition - which will include strategies of planning, monitoring, evaluation, and choice of what to learn.
parts: 为了让孩子能最有效地调节自己的学习，
可以帮助每个孩子认识自己的学习方式。这种认识称为“元认知”，其中包括制订计划、监控、评估和选择学习内容的策略。
terms: 元认知（对自身认知过程的认识和调节）

12.en: Emotional awareness is also part of metacognition, so children should be helped to be aware of their feelings around the area to be learned, feelings of curiosity or confidence, for example.
parts: 觉察自己的情绪也是元认知的一部分，因此应帮助孩子留意自己对所学领域的感受，例如好奇或自信。

15.en: Overviewing research on the thinking process of highly able children, (Shore and Kanevsky, 1993) put the instructor’s problem succinctly: ‘If they [the gifted] merely think more quickly, then we need only teach more quickly.
parts: 肖尔和卡内夫斯基（1993年）在综述能力出众的儿童如何思考的研究时，简明地指出了教师面临的问题。
“如果他们〔指天赋儿童〕只是思考得更快，那么我们只需教得更快。

24.en: Given that a fundamental goal of education is to transfer the control of learning from teachers to pupils, improving pupils’ learning to learn techniques should be a major outcome of the school experience, especially for the highly competent.
parts: 教育的一项根本目标，是把学习的主导权从教师手中交给学生。
有鉴于此，提高学生“学会学习”的能力，理应是学校教育的一项重要成果，对能力很强的学生尤其如此。

25.en: There are quite a number of new methods which can help, such as child-initiated learning, ability-peer tutoring, etc.
parts: 有不少新方法可以提供帮助，例如由孩子主动发起的学习、能力相近的同伴间的辅导等。
terms: 由孩子主动发起的学习
能力相近的同伴间的辅导

26.en: Such practices have been found to be particularly useful for bright children from deprived areas.
parts: 研究发现，这些做法对来自贫困地区的聪颖儿童特别有用。

27.en: But scientific progress is not all theoretical, knowledge is also vital to outstanding performance: individuals who know a great deal about a specific domain will achieve at a higher level than those who do not (Elshout, 1995).
parts: 但科学进步并非全是理论性的，知识对于取得出色的表现也至关重要。
对某个特定领域了解甚深的人，其成就水平会高于缺乏这方面知识的人（埃尔斯豪特，1995年）。

28.en: Research with creative scientists by Simonton (1988) brought him to the conclusion that above a certain high level, characteristics such as independence seemed to contribute more to reaching the highest levels of expertise than intellectual skills, due to the great demands of effort and time needed for learning and practice.
parts: 西蒙顿（1988年）对富有创造力的科学家进行了研究，并得出如下结论。
在达到某个较高水平之后，要取得最高水平的专业造诣，独立性等特质似乎比智力技能作用更大，
因为学习和练习都需要投入大量精力和时间。
terms: 在达到某个较高水平之后

6.en: The vocabulary aspect, for example, is dependent on having heard those words.
parts: 例如，测验中词汇这一项的表现，就取决于孩子以前是否听过那些词。

2.en: This search, often known by the acronym SETI (search for extra-terrestrial intelligence), is a difficult one.
parts: 这项搜寻工作很艰难，通常简称SETI，即“搜寻地外智慧生命”。

8.en: In this sense, SETI is another cog in the machinery of pure science which is continually pushing out the horizon of our knowledge.
parts: 从这个意义上说，搜寻地外智慧生命也是纯科学这部机器中的一个齿轮，而纯科学正在不断拓展我们的知识边界。

15.en: It is even possible that the older civilisation may pass on the benefits of their experience in dealing with threats to survival such as nuclear war and global pollution, and other threats that we haven’t yet discovered.
parts: 那种更古老的文明甚至可能把经验传给我们，使我们也能从中获益。
这些经验涉及应对生存威胁，如核战争、全球污染，以及我们尚未发现的其他威胁。

16.en: In discussing whether we are alone, most SETI scientists adopt two ground rules.
parts: 在讨论人类是否是宇宙中唯一的智慧生命时，多数从事地外智慧生命搜寻的科学家遵循两条基本规则。

18.en: Second, we make a very conservative assumption that we are looking for a life form that is pretty well like us, since if it differs radically from us we may well not recognise it as a life form, quite apart from whether we are able to communicate with it.
parts: 其次，我们作了一个十分保守的假设：我们寻找的是与我们大体相似的生命形式。
因为如果它与我们截然不同，我们很可能连它是生命都认不出来，更不用说能否与之交流了。

25.en: Descriptive grammarians have been presented as people who do not care about standards, because of the way they see all forms of usage as equally valid.
parts: 描写派语法学家把各种语言用法都视为同样合理。正因为如此，他们被描绘成不在乎语言规范的人。

26.en: Prescriptive grammarians have been presented as blind adherents to a historical tradition.
parts: 规定派语法学家则被描绘成盲目追随某一历史传统的人。

27.en: The opposition has even been presented in quasi-political terms - of radical liberalism vs elitist conservatism.
parts: 人们甚至用近乎政治化的措辞来描述这种对立，将其说成激进自由主义与精英保守主义的对抗。

11.en: The variety which is favoured, in this account, is usually a version of the standard written language, especially as encountered in literature, or in the formal spoken language which most closely reflects this style.
parts: 按照这种看法，受到推崇的语言变体通常是标准书面语的一种形式，尤其指文学作品中的书面语，或是最接近这种文体的正式口语。

12.en: Adherents to this variety are said to speak or write ‘correctly’; deviations from it are said to be ‘incorrect’.
parts: 遵循这种语言变体的人，被认为说得或写得“正确”；偏离这种变体的用法，则被认为是“错误的”。

13.en: All the main languages have been studied prescriptively, especially in the 18th century approach to the writing of grammars and dictionaries.
parts: 各种主要语言都曾有人从规范主义的角度加以研究，这在18世纪编写语法书和词典的方式中表现得尤为明显。

14.en: The aims of these early grammarians were threefold: (a) they wanted to codify the principles of their languages, to show that there was a system beneath the apparent chaos of usage, (b) they wanted a means of settling disputes over usage, and (c) they wanted to point out what they felt to be common errors, in order to ‘improve’ the language.
parts: 这些早期语法学家有三个目的：第一，把各自语言的原则整理成系统，表明看似混乱的用法其实有规律可循；
第二，找到一种解决用法争议的办法；
第三，指出他们所认为的常见错误，以便“改进”语言。

7.en: No part of society or social behaviour is exempt: linguistic factors influence how we judge personality, intelligence, social status, educational standards, job aptitude, and many other areas of identity and social survival.
parts: 社会的任何领域、任何一种社会行为都受语言的影响。
语言因素影响着我们如何判断一个人的性格、智力、社会地位、受教育水平和工作才能，
也影响我们对身份认同和社会生存的许多其他方面的判断。

20.en: This approach is summarised in the statement that it is the task of the grammarian to describe, not prescribe -to record the facts of linguistic diversity, and not to attempt the impossible tasks of evaluating language variation or halting language change.
parts: 这种做法可以用一句话概括：语法学家的职责是描述语言，而非规定语言应当怎样使用。
也就是说，要记录语言多样性的事实，
无需尝试去做那些不可能做到的事：评判语言变异，或阻止语言演变。

18.en: If insects paid attention to such advertisements, they might be prompted to lay their eggs on a duller, and presumably less resistant host.
parts: 如果昆虫留意到这样的信号，它们就可能转而在颜色较暗淡、抗虫能力想必也较弱的寄主植物上产卵。

6.en: For many trees — evergreen conifers being an exception — the best strategy is to abandon photosynthesis until the spring.
parts: 对许多树木来说（常绿针叶树除外），最佳策略是暂时停止光合作用，直到春天。

16.en: However there are problems with each of these theories, including the fact that leaves are red for such a relatively short period that the expense of energy needed to manufacture the anthocyanins would outweigh any anti-fungal or anti-herbivore activity achieved.
parts: 不过，这些理论各有问题。例如，叶片呈红色的时间相对短暂，
以至于合成花青素所耗费的能量，会超过它在抵御真菌或植食动物方面带来的任何益处。

17.en: It has also been proposed that trees may produce vivid red colours to convince herbivorous insects that they are healthy and robust and would be easily able to mount chemical defences against infestation.
parts: 还有人提出，树木可能会呈现鲜艳的红色，
借此让植食性昆虫相信，这些树健康而强壮，能够轻易启动化学防御来抵御虫害。

15.en: Some theories about anthocyanins have argued that they might act as a chemical defence against attacks by insects or fungi, or that they might attract fruit-eating birds or increase a leaf’s tolerance to freezing.
parts: 有些关于花青素的理论认为，它们可能起到化学防御作用，抵御昆虫或真菌的侵袭，
也可能吸引以果实为食的鸟类，或提高叶片对冰冻的耐受力。

21.en: Perhaps the most plausible suggestion as to why leaves would go to the trouble of making anthocyanins when they’re busy packing up for the winter is the theory known as the ‘light screen’ hypothesis.
parts: 树叶忙着为过冬做准备，为什么还要费力制造花青素？
对此，最说得通的解释或许是被称为“遮光屏”假说的那种理论。

23.en: Why does chlorophyll need protection when it is the natural world’s supreme light absorber?
parts: 既然叶绿素是自然界最出色的吸光物质，它为什么还需要保护？

28.en: The weakened fall leaf then becomes vulnerable to the highly destructive effects of the oxygen created by the excited chlorophyll molecules.
parts: 这样一来，已变得脆弱的秋叶就容易受到损伤：处于激发态的叶绿素分子产生的氧具有很强的破坏作用。

32.en: It has also been recognised for decades that the best conditions for intense red colours are dry, sunny days and cool nights, conditions that nicely match those that make leaves susceptible to excess light.
parts: 数十年来，人们也已认识到，要让秋叶呈现浓艳的红色，最适宜的条件是干燥、晴朗的白天和凉爽的夜晚。
这些条件恰好也使叶片容易受到过强光照的伤害。

21.en: In response, the researchers issued a review of all the ganzfeld studies done up to 1985 to show that 80 per cent had found statistically significant evidence.
parts: 作为回应，研究人员发表了一篇综述，梳理截至1985年开展的所有甘兹费尔德实验，
旨在说明其中80%的研究发现了具有统计显著性的证据。

1.en: Can human beings communicate by thought alone?
parts: 人类能单凭思想进行交流吗？

2.en: For more than a century the issue of telepathy has divided the scientific community, and even today it still sparks bitter controversy among top academics
parts: 一个多世纪以来，心灵感应问题一直让科学界意见分歧，直到今天仍在顶尖学者之间引发激烈争论。

3.en: Since the 1970s, parapsychologists at leading universities and research institutes around the world have risked the derision of sceptical colleagues by putting the various claims for telepathy to the test in dozens of rigorous scientific studies.
parts: 自20世纪70年代以来，世界各地一流大学和研究机构的超心理学家冒着被持怀疑态度的同行嘲笑的风险，
开展了数十项严谨的科学研究，以检验关于心灵感应的种种说法。

4.en: The results and their implications are dividing even the researchers who uncovered them.
parts: 就连发现这些结果的研究人员，对结果本身及其含义也存在分歧。

5.en: Some researchers say the results constitute compelling evidence that telepathy is genuine.
parts: 一些研究人员认为，这些结果构成了令人信服的证据，表明心灵感应确实存在。

6.en: Other parapsychologists believe the field is on the brink of collapse, having tried to produce definitive scientific proof and failed.
parts: 另一些超心理学家则认为，这一研究领域已濒临崩溃，因为研究者虽曾尝试拿出确凿的科学证据，却未能成功。

7.en: Sceptics and advocates alike do concur on one issue, however: that the most impressive evidence so far has come from the so-called ‘ganzfeld’ experiments, a German term that means ‘whole field’.
parts: 不过，怀疑者和支持者确实有一点意见一致：
迄今最引人注目的证据来自所谓的“甘兹费尔德”实验；这个德语词的意思是“全场”。

8.en: Reports of telepathic experiences had by people during meditation led parapsychologists to suspect that telepathy might involve ‘signals’ passing between people that were so faint that they were usually swamped by normal brain activity.
parts: 有人报告说，自己在冥想时有过心灵感应的体验。这使超心理学家猜想，
心灵感应可能涉及人与人之间传递的“信号”，而这些信号极其微弱，通常会被正常的脑部活动淹没。

9.en: In this case, such signals might be more easily detected by those experiencing meditation-like tranquillity in a relaxing ‘whole field’ of light, sound and warmth.
parts: 如果是这样，置身于光、声音和暖意营造的放松“全场”中、体验着冥想般宁静的人，也许更容易察觉这些信号。

10.en: The ganzfeld experiment tries to recreate these conditions with participants sitting in soft reclining chairs in a sealed room, listening to relaxing sounds while their eyes are covered with special filters letting in only soft pink light.
parts: 甘兹费尔德实验试图重现这些条件：参与者坐在密闭房间里柔软的躺椅上，
耳边听着令人放松的声音，眼前则罩着特殊的滤光片，只容许柔和的粉色光线透过。

11.en: In early ganzfeld experiments, the telepathy test involved identification of a picture chosen from a random selection of four taken from a large image bank.
parts: 早期甘兹费尔德实验的心灵感应测试要求辨认一幅图片：先从大型图库中随机抽取四幅，再从这四幅中选出一幅作为目标。

12.en: The idea was that a person acting as a ‘sender’ would attempt to beam the image over to the ‘receiver’ relaxing in the sealed room.
parts: 实验的设想是，由一人充当“发送者”，试图用意念把图像传给正在密闭房间里放松的“接收者”。
terms: 传送；此处指用意念传送

13.en: Once the session was over, this person was asked to identify which of the four images had been used.
parts: 这一轮实验结束后，研究人员请接收者指出四幅图中哪一幅是刚才使用的。

14.en: Random guessing would give a hit-rate of 25 per cent; if telepathy is real, however, the hit-rate would be higher.
parts: 随机猜测的命中率会是25%。不过，如果心灵感应确实存在，命中率就会更高。

15.en: In 1982, the results from the first ganzfeld studies were analysed by one of its pioneers, the American parapsychologist Charles Honorton.
parts: 1982年，美国超心理学家查尔斯·霍诺顿分析了最早几项甘兹费尔德研究的结果；他是这项研究的开拓者之一。

16.en: They pointed to typical hit-rates of better than 30 per cent - a small effect, but one which statistical tests suggested could not be put down to chance.
parts: 这些结果表明，典型的命中率在30%以上。
这个效应虽小，但统计检验提示，它不能归因于偶然。

17.en: The implication was that the ganzfeld method had revealed real evidence for telepathy.
parts: 这意味着，甘兹费尔德方法揭示了支持心灵感应的真实证据。
terms: 言下之意；所蕴含的结论

18.en: But there was a crucial flaw in this argument — one routinely overlooked in more conventional areas of science.
parts: 但这一论证有一个关键漏洞，而在更常规的科学领域，同样的漏洞也经常被忽略。

19.en: Just because chance had been ruled out as an explanation did not prove telepathy must exist; there were many other ways of getting positive results.
parts: 排除了偶然性这一解释，并不能证明心灵感应就一定存在；还有许多别的途径也会产生阳性结果。

20.en: These ranged from ‘sensory leakage’ - where clues about the pictures accidentally reach the receiver - to outright fraud.
parts: 这些可能性从“感官信息泄漏”一直到公然造假；前者指的是有关图片的线索无意间传到了接收者那里。

22.en: However, they also agreed that there were still too many problems in the experiments which could lead to positive results, and they drew up a list demanding new standards for future research.
parts: 不过，研究人员也承认，实验中仍有太多问题可能造成阳性结果。
他们列出一份清单，要求未来的研究采用新的标准。

23.en: After this, many researchers switched to autoganzfeld tests - an automated variant of the technique which used computers to perform many of the key tasks such as the random selection of images.
parts: 此后，许多研究人员改用自动化甘兹费尔德测试。
它是原有技术的自动化变体，用计算机完成随机选图等多项关键任务。
terms: 自动化甘兹费尔德测试

24.en: By minimising human involvement, the idea was to minimise the risk of flawed results.
parts: 这样设计是想尽量减少人为介入，从而尽量降低结果出现偏差的风险。

25.en: In 1987, results from hundreds of autoganzfeld tests were studied by Honorton in a ‘meta-analysis’, a statistical technique for finding the overall results from a set of studies.
parts: 1987年，霍诺顿用“荟萃分析”研究了数百次自动化甘兹费尔德测试的结果。
这是一种综合一组研究、得出总体结果的统计方法。
terms: 自动化甘兹费尔德测试

26.en: Though less compelling than before, the outcome was still impressive.
parts: 这次的结果虽然没有先前那样有说服力，却依然引人注目。

27.en: Yet some parapsychologists remain disturbed by the lack of consistency between individual ganzfeld studies.
parts: 不过，各项甘兹费尔德研究的结果并不一致，这仍让一些超心理学家感到不安。

28.en: Defenders of telepathy point out that demanding impressive evidence from every study ignores one basic statistical fact: it takes large samples to detect small effects.
parts: 心灵感应的支持者指出，要求每项研究都拿出引人注目的证据，忽略了一个基本统计事实：
要检测出微小的效应，就需要大样本。

29.en: If, as current results suggest, telepathy produces hit-rates only marginally above the 25 per cent expected by chance, it’s unlikely to be detected by a typical ganzfeld study involving around 40 people: the group is just not big enough.
parts: 如果像现有结果所提示的那样，心灵感应带来的命中率仅比随机猜测预期的25%高一点，
那么，在一项通常只有约四十人参加的甘兹费尔德研究中，这种效应就不大可能被检测出来：样本实在不够大。

30.en: Only when many studies are combined in a meta-analysis will the faint signal of telepathy really become apparent.
parts: 只有把许多研究合在一起进行荟萃分析，微弱的心灵感应信号才会真正显现。

31.en: And that is what researchers do seem to be finding.
parts: 而研究者们似乎确实正在发现这样的信号。

32.en: What they are certainly not finding, however, is any change in attitude of mainstream scientists: most still totally reject the very idea of telepathy.
parts: 不过，研究者们肯定没有发现主流科学家的态度有任何改变。
大多数主流科学家仍然完全不接受心灵感应这一想法本身。

33.en: The problem stems at least in part from the lack of any plausible mechanism for telepathy.
parts: 问题至少部分在于，人们还提不出任何说得通的机制来解释心灵感应。

34.en: Various theories have been put forward, many focusing on esoteric ideas from theoretical physics.
parts: 人们提出了各种理论，其中许多都聚焦于理论物理学中深奥的概念。

35.en: They include ‘quantum entanglement’, in which events affecting one group of atoms instantly affect another group, no matter how far apart they may be.
parts: 其中包括“量子纠缠”。在这种情形下，影响一组原子的事件会立即影响另一组，无论两组原子相距多远。

36.en: While physicists have demonstrated entanglement with specially prepared atoms, no-one knows if it also exists between atoms making up human minds.
parts: 尽管物理学家已用专门制备的原子展示了纠缠现象，但谁也不知道，构成人类心智的原子之间是否也存在这种现象。

37.en: Answering such questions would transform parapsychology.
parts: 如果能回答这些问题，超心理学就会发生根本变化。

38.en: This has prompted some researchers to argue that the future lies not in collecting more evidence for telepathy, but in probing possible mechanisms.
parts: 这使一些研究人员提出，今后的方向不在于收集更多支持心灵感应的证据，而在于探究可能的机制。

39.en: Some work has begun already, with researchers trying to identify people who are particularly successful in autoganzfeld trials.
parts: 一些工作已经展开。研究人员正设法找出在自动化甘兹费尔德试验中表现特别出色的人。

40.en: Early results show that creative and artistic people do much better than average: in one study at the University of Edinburgh, musicians achieved a hit-rate of 56 per cent.
parts: 初步结果显示，富有创造力和艺术天赋者的表现远高于平均水平。
在爱丁堡大学的一项研究中，音乐家的命中率达到了56%。

41.en: Perhaps more tests like these will eventually give the researchers the evidence they are seeking and strengthen the case for the existence of telepathy.
parts: 也许更多这样的测试最终会给研究人员提供他们正在寻找的证据，从而使支持心灵感应存在的理由更有说服力。

10.en: The perception of smell, therefore, consists not only of the sensation of the odours themselves, but of the experiences and emotions associated with them.
parts: 因此，对气味的感知不仅包括对气味本身的感觉，也包括与这些气味相联系的经历和情感。
