parts: 细胞利用食物中的葡萄糖生成ATP（三磷酸腺苷），这种分子为体内许多活动供能。

32.en: By limiting food intake, caloric restriction minimizes the amount of glucose entering cells and decreases ATP generation.
parts: 限制热量摄入是通过减少进食量，把进入细胞的葡萄糖量降到最低，同时减少ATP的生成。

33.en: When 2DG is administered to animals that eat normally, glucose reaches cells in abundance but the drug prevents most of it from being processed and thus reduces ATP synthesis.
parts: 正常进食的动物用上2DG时，仍有大量葡萄糖进入细胞，
但这种药物使其中大部分不能被代谢，从而减少了ATP的合成。

34.en: Researchers have proposed several explanations for why interruption of glucose processing and ATP production might retard aging.
parts: 为什么干扰葡萄糖代谢和ATP生成可能延缓衰老？研究人员对此提出了几种解释。

35.en: One possibility relates to the ATP-making machinery’s emission of free radicals, which are thought to contribute to aging and to such age-related diseases as cancer by damaging cells.
parts: 一种可能的解释与产生ATP的系统释放自由基有关。
人们认为，自由基会损伤细胞，从而促成衰老，还会促成癌症等与年龄有关的疾病。

36.en: Reduced operation of the machinery should limit their production and thereby constrain the damage.
parts: 这套系统的运转减弱，应该会减少自由基的产生，从而限制细胞受到的损伤。

37.en: Another hypothesis suggests that decreased processing of glucose could indicate to cells that food is scarce (even if it isn’t) and induce them to shift into an anti-aging mode that emphasizes preservation of the organism over such ‘luxuries’ as growth and reproduction.
parts: 另一种假说认为，葡萄糖代谢减少可能向细胞传递食物短缺的信号（即使实际上并不短缺），
使细胞转入一种抗衰老模式。在这种模式下，维持机体生存优先于生长和繁殖之类的“奢侈”活动。

3.en: As researchers on aging noted recently, no treatment on the market today has been proved to slow human aging - the build-up of molecular and cellular damage that increases vulnerability to infirmity as we grow older.
parts: 正如衰老研究人员近来所指出的，目前市面上还没有任何疗法被证实能延缓人的衰老。
这里说的衰老是指，分子和细胞损伤逐渐积累，使我们随着年龄增长更容易变得虚弱。

4.en: But one intervention, consumption of a low-calorie yet nutritionally balanced diet, works incredibly well in a broad range of animals, increasing longevity and prolonging good health.
parts: 不过，有一种干预措施对许多种动物都格外有效。这就是在限制热量摄入的同时保持饮食营养均衡，
它能延长寿命，也能让动物保持健康的时间更长。

9.en: Could such a ‘caloric-restriction mimetic’, as we call it, enable people to stay healthy longer, postponing age-related disorders (such as diabetes, arteriosclerosis, heart disease and cancer) until very late in life?
parts: 我们把这种物质叫作“热量限制模拟物”。它有没有可能让人更长久地保持健康，
将糖尿病、动脉硬化、心脏病和癌症等与年龄有关的疾病推迟到人生的最后阶段才出现？

14.en: Scientists first recognized the value of the practice more than 60 years ago, when they found that rats fed a low-calorie diet lived longer on average than free-feeding rats and also had a reduced incidence of conditions that become increasingly common in old age.
parts: 早在60多年前，科学家就首次认识到了这种做法的价值。
当时他们发现，喂食低热量饮食的大鼠平均寿命比自由进食的大鼠更长，
而且一些随年龄增长愈发常见的疾病，在前一组大鼠中的发病率也更低。

22.en: For example, they have lower blood pressure and triglyceride levels (signifying a decreased likelihood of heart disease), and they have more normal blood glucose levels (pointing to a reduced risk for diabetes, which is marked by unusually high blood glucose levels).
parts: 例如，它们的血压和甘油三酯水平均更低，这意味着患心脏病的可能性降低。
它们的血糖水平也更接近正常，表明患糖尿病的风险较低；血糖异常升高正是糖尿病的特征。

2.en: As one writer observes: ‘Although it is now evident that artefacts are as easily altered as chronicles, public faith in their veracity endures: a tangible relic seems ipso facto real.’
parts: 正如一位作者所说：“如今人们已经清楚，文物和编年史一样容易被改动，
但公众依然相信文物真实无伪。遗物是有形的，单凭这一点，人们就觉得它是真的。”

12.en: On so-called heritage sites the re-enactment of historical events is increasingly popular, and computers will soon provide virtual reality experiences, which will present visitors with a vivid image of the period of their choice, in which they themselves can act as if part of the historical environment.
parts: 在所谓的历史遗址，历史事件重演越来越受欢迎。计算机也将很快提供虚拟现实体验，
让游客生动地看到自己选择的历史时期，仿佛置身当时的环境，亲自参与其中。

14.en: In a related development, the sharp distinction between museum and heritage sites on the one hand, and theme parks on the other, is gradually evaporating.
parts: 与此相关的另一个变化是，博物馆和历史遗址与主题公园之间原本鲜明的界线，正在逐渐消失。

16.en: For example, museums have adopted story lines for exhibitions, sites have accepted ‘theming’ as a relevant tool, and theme parks are moving towards more authenticity and research-based presentations.
parts: 例如，博物馆开始用故事线索串联展览，历史遗址也认可围绕主题来组织展示的做法，
而主题公园则越来越重视真实性，并以研究为依据来安排展示。

17.en: In zoos, animals are no longer kept in cages, but in great spaces, either in the open air or in enormous greenhouses, such as the jungle and desert environments in Burgers’ Zoo in Holland.
parts: 在动物园里，动物已不再关在笼中，而是养在宽阔的空间里，有的在露天，有的在巨大的温室里。
荷兰伯格斯动物园内的丛林和沙漠环境便是例子。

28.en: There is one compensation, however, for the professionals who make these interpretations: if they did not provide the interpretation, visitors would do it for themselves, based on their own ideas, misconceptions and prejudices.
parts: 不过，对于作出这些解读的专业人员来说，有一点可以聊以自慰。
如果他们不提供解读，游客也会根据自己的想法、误解和偏见自行解释。

4.en: Museums used to look - and some still do - much like storage rooms of objects packed together in showcases: good for scholars who wanted to study the subtle differences in design, but not for the ordinary visitor, to whom it all looked alike.
parts: 过去的博物馆很像储藏室，各种物件挤在陈列柜里，有些博物馆至今还是这样。
这种布置适合想研究设计细微差别的学者，却不适合普通参观者。在他们看来，这些东西都差不多。

23.en: Those who are professionally engaged in the art of interpreting history are thus in a difficult position, as they must steer a narrow course between the demands of ‘evidence’ and ‘attractiveness’ especially given the increasing need in the heritage industry for income-generating activities.
parts: 因此，专门从事历史解读的人处境艰难。
他们必须在“证据”和“吸引力”两方面的要求之间谨慎权衡，尤其是考虑到文化遗产行业越来越需要能够创收的活动。

34.en: In a town like Leyden in Holland, which in the seventeenth century was occupied by approximately the same number of inhabitants as today, people lived within the walled town, an area more than five times smaller than modern Leyden.
parts: 以荷兰莱顿为例，十七世纪时的居民人数与今天大致相同，
但当时人们住在城墙以内，那片区域的面积还不到现代莱顿的五分之一。
terms: more than five times smaller than
more than five times smaller than

30.en: However, according to an article in the Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society, the damage it did was estimated at US$4 billion but the benefits amounted to some US$19 billion.
parts: 不过，据《美国气象学会通报》的一篇文章估算，这次厄尔尼诺造成的损失为40亿美元，带来的收益却约有190亿美元。

1.en: Educating Psyche by Bernie Neville is a book which looks at radical new approaches to learning, describing the effects of emotion, imagination and the unconscious on learning.
parts: 伯尼·内维尔在《心智教育》一书中探讨了突破常规的学习方法，
并阐述了情感、想象力和无意识对学习的影响。

2.en: One theory discussed in the book is that proposed by George Lozanov, which focuses on the power of suggestion.
parts: 书中讨论的理论之一由乔治·洛扎诺夫提出，着重探讨暗示的力量。

6.en: If we think of a lecture we listened to with great concentration, we will recall the lecturer’s appearance and mannerisms, our place in the auditorium, the failure of the air-conditioning, much more easily than the ideas we went to learn.
parts: 回想一场我们曾全神贯注听过的讲座，讲者的外貌和习惯动作、我们在听众席上的座位，以及空调出了故障这些事，
都比我们原本想从中学到的观点更容易回忆起来。

7.en: Even if these peripheral details are a bit elusive, they come back readily in hypnosis or when we relive the event imaginatively, as in psychodrama.
parts: 即使这些无关主旨的细节有些难以回想，在催眠状态下，或在想象中重温当时的情景时（如在心理剧中），它们也很容易重新浮现。

10.en: Lozanov therefore made indirect instruction (suggestion) central to his teaching system.
parts: 因此，洛扎诺夫把间接教学（即暗示）置于其教学体系的核心。

40.en: While suggestopedia has gained some notoriety through success in the teaching of modern languages, few teachers are able to emulate the spectacular results of Lozanov and his associates.
parts: 暗示教学法虽然因在现代语言教学中取得成功而颇受瞩目，但很少有教师能取得洛扎诺夫及其同事那样引人注目的成效。
terms: 努力达到与……相同的水平

8.en: The details of the content of the lecture, on the other hand, seem to have gone forever.
parts: 相比之下，讲座内容的细节却仿佛再也想不起来了。

3.en: Lozanov’s instructional technique is based on the evidence that the connections made in the brain through unconscious processing (which he calls non-specific mental reactivity) are more durable than those made through conscious processing.
parts: 洛扎诺夫的教学方法有这样的证据作为依据：大脑通过无意识加工（他称之为“非特异性心理反应”）建立的联系，
比通过有意识加工建立的联系更为持久。

5.en: If we think of a book we studied months or years ago, we will find it easier to recall peripheral details - the colour, the binding, the typeface, the table at the library where we sat while studying it - than the content on which we were concentrating.
parts: 回想几个月或几年前研读过的一本书，我们会发现，较容易回忆起来的是一些次要细节，
例如书的颜色、装帧、字体，还有我们在图书馆读这本书时坐的那张桌子。
相比之下，当时专心研读的内容反而更难回想。

9.en: This phenomenon can be partly attributed to the common counterproductive approach to study (making extreme efforts to memorise, tensing muscles, inducing fatigue), but it also simply reflects the way the brain functions.
parts: 这种现象部分可以归因于一种常见却适得其反的学习方法（拼命记忆、绷紧肌肉，因而感到疲劳），
但它也只是反映了大脑本身的运作方式。

33.en: Another difference from conventional teaching is the evidence that students can regularly learn 1000 new words of a foreign language during a suggestopedic session, as well as grammar and idiom.
parts: 与常规教学相比，还有一点不同：有证据表明，学生在一节暗示教学课上常常能学会一千个外语生词，外加语法和习语。

39.en: Just as a doctor calls on the full power of autocratic suggestion by insisting that the patient take precisely this white capsule precisely three times a day before meals, Lozanov is categoric in insisting that the suggestopedic session be conducted exactly in the manner designated, by trained and accredited suggestopedic teachers.
parts: 正如医生会充分借助权威式暗示的力量，
坚称患者必须服用的就是这种白色胶囊，每天恰好三次，而且要在餐前服用，
洛扎诺夫也明确坚持，暗示教学课必须严格依照指定方式，由受过培训且取得资格的暗示教学法教师来上。
terms: 受过培训并取得资格的
使用暗示教学法的教师

4.en: Besides the laboratory evidence for this, we know from our experience that we often remember what we have perceived peripherally, long after we have forgotten what we set out to learn.
parts: 除了实验室的证据，我们自己也有这样的体验：原先想学的东西早已忘记，无意间注意到的细节却常常还记得。
terms: 在注意力未集中的情况下察觉到

11.en: In suggestopedia, as he called his method, consciousness is shifted away from the curriculum to focus on something peripheral.
parts: 洛扎诺夫把这种方法称为“暗示教学法”。在这种方法中，学生把有意识的注意力从课程内容转向某个与课程关系不大的事物。

12.en: The curriculum then becomes peripheral and is dealt with by the reserve capacity of the brain.
parts: 这样，课程内容就退到了注意力之外，由大脑的储备能力来处理。
terms: 储备能力；未充分利用的能力

13.en: The suggestopedic approach to foreign language learning provides a good illustration.
parts: 外语学习中的暗示教学法就是一个很好的例子。

14.en: In its most recent variant (1980), it consists of the reading of vocabulary and text while the class is listening to music.
parts: 在当时最新的版本（1980年）里，学生听着音乐，教师同时朗读词汇和课文。

15.en: The first session is in two parts.
parts: 第一节课分为两部分。

16.en: In the first part, the music is classical (Mozart, Beethoven, Brahms) and the teacher reads the text slowly and solemnly, with attention to the dynamics of the music.
parts: 第一部分播放古典音乐（莫扎特、贝多芬、勃拉姆斯的作品），教师缓慢、庄重地朗读课文，留意乐曲的强弱变化。

17.en: The students follow the text in their books.
parts: 学生看着书，跟随教师的朗读默读课文。

18.en: This is followed by several minutes of silence.
parts: 接下来是几分钟的静默。

19.en: In the second part, they listen to baroque music (Bach, Corelli, Handel) while the teacher reads the text in a normal speaking voice.
parts: 第二部分播放巴洛克音乐（巴赫、科雷利、亨德尔的作品），同时教师用平时说话的声音朗读课文。

20.en: During this time they have their books closed.
parts: 在这段时间里，学生一直合着书。

21.en: During the whole of this session, their attention is passive; they listen to the music but make no attempt to learn the material.
parts: 整节课上，学生都处于被动接收的状态：他们听音乐，却不刻意去学教材内容。

22.en: Beforehand, the students have been carefully prepared for the language learning experience.
parts: 上课之前，学生已经在细致的引导下为这次语言学习做好了准备。
terms: 已得到细致引导，为……做好准备

23.en: Through meeting with the staff and satisfied students they develop the expectation that learning will be easy and pleasant and that they will successfully learn several hundred words of the foreign language during the class.
parts: 通过和教职人员及对课程满意的学生见面，他们开始期待，学习会轻松愉快，
而且自己能在一节课上学会几百个外语单词。

24.en: In a preliminary talk, the teacher introduces them to the material to be covered, but does not ‘teach’ it.
parts: 在课前谈话中，教师向学生介绍将要学习的材料，但并不实际“教”这些内容。

25.en: Likewise, the students are instructed not to try to learn it during this introduction.
parts: 同样，教师也告诉学生，在这段介绍过程中不必刻意去学这些材料。

26.en: Some hours after the two-part session, there is a follow-up class at which the students are stimulated to recall the material presented.
parts: 两部分课程结束几小时后，还有一堂后续课，教师会引导学生回想先前接触的内容。

27.en: Once again the approach is indirect.
parts: 这一次，教学方式仍是间接的。

28.en: The students do not focus their attention on trying to remember the vocabulary, but focus on using the language to communicate (e.g. through games or improvised dramatisations).
parts: 学生把注意力放在用所学语言交流上（例如做游戏或即兴表演），而不刻意去回忆词汇。

29.en: Such methods are not unusual in language teaching.
parts: 这类方法在语言教学中并不少见。

30.en: What is distinctive in the suggestopedic method is that they are devoted entirely to assisting recall.
parts: 暗示教学法的独特之处在于，这些活动完全是为了帮助学生回忆所学内容。

31.en: The ‘learning’ of the material is assumed to be automatic and effortless, accomplished while listening to music.
parts: 这种教学法认为，对材料的“学习”在听音乐时就自动完成了，不用刻意费力。

32.en: The teacher’s task is to assist the students to apply what they have learned paraconsciously, and in doing so to make it easily accessible to consciousness.
parts: 教师的任务是帮助学生运用在意识之外学到的知识，从而使他们能够轻松地、有意识地调用这些知识。
terms: 在意识之外地（指学习过程）

34.en: Lozanov experimented with teaching by direct suggestion during sleep, hypnosis and trance states, but found such procedures unnecessary.
parts: 洛扎诺夫曾尝试在睡眠、催眠和恍惚状态下以直接暗示进行教学，但他发现这些做法并无必要。

35.en: Hypnosis, yoga, Silva mind-control, religious ceremonies and faith healing are all associated with successful suggestion, but none of their techniques seem to be essential to it.
parts: 催眠、瑜伽、席尔瓦心灵控制法、宗教仪式和信仰疗法都与成功的暗示有关，但其中似乎没有哪种技巧是暗示起效所必需的。

36.en: Such rituals may be seen as placebos.
parts: 这类仪式可以看作安慰剂。

37.en: Lozanov acknowledges that the ritual surrounding suggestion in his own system is also a placebo, but maintains that without such a placebo people are unable or afraid to tap the reserve capacity of their brains.
parts: 洛扎诺夫承认，他自己的体系中，伴随暗示而来的仪式也是一种安慰剂，
但他坚持认为，缺少这种安慰剂，人们就不能或不敢动用大脑的储备能力。

38.en: Like any placebo, it must be dispensed with authority to be effective.
parts: 和任何安慰剂一样，这种仪式也得由施行者带着权威感来实施，才能奏效。

41.en: We can, perhaps, attribute mediocre results to an inadequate placebo effect.
parts: 效果平平，或许是因为安慰剂效应不够强。

42.en: The students have not developed the appropriate mind set.
parts: 学生还没有形成适合这种学习方法的心态。

43.en: They are often not motivated to learn through this method.
parts: 他们往往缺乏采用这种方法学习的动力。
他们对这种方法缺少足够的“信心”。

45.en: They do not see it as ‘real teaching’, especially as it does not seem to involve the ‘work’ they have learned to believe is essential to learning.
parts: 他们不把这当作“真正的教学”，尤其是因为这种方法似乎不要求他们付出那种他们一向认为学习必需的“功夫”。

20.en: Dunn (1988) points out that it is in such day-to-day relationships and interactions that the child’s understanding of his- or herself emerges.
parts: 邓恩（1988）指出，儿童对自己的认识，正是在这些日常关系和互动中逐渐形成的。

3.en: William James introduced the distinction in 1892, and contemporaries of his, such as Charles Cooley, added to the developing debate.
parts: 威廉·詹姆斯在1892年提出了这一区分，
查尔斯·库利等同时代学者也参与了随后展开的讨论。

6.en: This is an aspect of the self that he labelled ‘self-as-subject’, and he gave it various elements.
parts: 他把自我的这一方面称为“主体自我”，并提出它包含若干要素。

7.en: These included an awareness of one’s own agency (i. e. one’s power to act), and an awareness of one’s distinctiveness from other people.
parts: 其中包括两种认识：一是意识到自己能够主动行动，二是意识到自己有别于他人。

9.en: Cooley (1902) suggested that a sense of the self-as-subject was primarily concerned with being able to exercise power.
parts: 库利（1902年）认为，主体自我意识主要与能够对事物施加影响有关。

17.en: However, Lewis and Brooks-Gunn (1979) suggest that infants’ developing understanding that the movements they see in the mirror are contingent on their own, leads to a growing awareness that they are distinct from other people.
parts: 不过，刘易斯和布鲁克斯－冈恩（1979年）提出，婴儿会逐渐明白，镜中看到的动作取决于自己怎么动，
进而越来越清楚地意识到自己与他人有别。

18.en: This is because they, and only they, can change the reflection in the mirror.
parts: 这是因为婴儿自己，也只有他们自己，才能让镜中的影像发生变化。

21.en: Empirical investigations of the self-as-subject in young children are, however, rather scarce because of difficulties of communication: even if young infants can reflect on their experience, they certainly cannot express this aspect of the self directly.
parts: 然而，由于沟通困难，关于幼儿主体自我的实证研究相当少。
即使很小的婴儿能反思自己的经历，他们也肯定无法直接表达自我的这一方面。

23.en: This second step in the development of a full sense of self is what James called the ‘self-as-object’.
parts: 形成完整自我意识的第二步，就是詹姆斯所说的“客体自我”。

24.en: This has been seen by many to be the aspect of the self which is most influenced by social elements, since it is made up of social roles (such as student, brother, colleague) and characteristics which derive their meaning from comparison or interaction with other people (such as trustworthiness, shyness, sporting ability).
parts: 许多人认为，自我的这一方面受社会因素的影响最大，
因为它由社会角色（如学生、兄弟、同事）以及个人特征构成。
这些特征的意义来自与他人的比较或互动，例如是否值得信赖、是否害羞、运动能力如何。

26.en: Cooley believed that people build up their sense of identity from the reactions of others to them, and from the view they believe others have of them.
parts: 库利认为，人们通过两个方面建立对自己身份的认同：别人对自己的反应，以及自己心目中别人对自己的看法。

27.en: He called the self-as-object the ‘looking-glass self’, since people come to see themselves as they are reflected in others.
parts: 他把客体自我称为“镜中自我”，因为人们逐渐学会通过他人映照出的形象来看待自己。

28.en: Mead (1934) went even further, and saw the self and the social world as inextricably bound together: ‘The self is essentially a social structure, and it arises in social experience... it is impossible to conceive of a self arising outside of social experience.’
parts: 米德（1934年）更进一步，认为自我和社会世界密不可分。
“自我本质上是一种社会结构，产生于社会经验之中……
无法设想自我能在社会经验之外产生。”

29.en: Lewis and Brooks-Gunn argued that an important developmental milestone is reached when children become able to recognize themselves visually without the support of seeing contingent movement.
parts: 刘易斯和布鲁克斯－冈恩认为，儿童单凭视觉就能认出自己，无须再借助镜中影像随自己而动这一线索时，便达到了一个重要的发展里程碑。
terms: 随着自身动作而变化的运动

30.en: This recognition occurs around their second birthday.
parts: 这种识别能力大约在儿童两岁生日前后出现。

19.en: This understanding that children gain of themselves as active agents continues to develop in their attempts to co-operate with others in play.
parts: 儿童逐渐认识到自己能主动做事。在游戏中尝试与他人合作时，他们对这一点的认识还会继续发展。

39.en: He points out that climate data obtained from slow-growing corals around the Pacific indicate a series of unusually frequent El Niños around the time of the Lapita expansion.
parts: 他指出，从太平洋各地生长缓慢的珊瑚中获取的气候数据显示，
在拉皮塔人扩张前后，厄尔尼诺现象接连发生，频率异乎寻常。

2.en: An important archaeological discovery on the island of Efate in the Pacific archipelago of Vanuatu has revealed traces of an ancient seafaring people, the distant ancestors of today’s Polynesians.
parts: 在太平洋瓦努阿图群岛的埃法特岛上，一项重要的考古发现揭示了一个古代航海民族的踪迹。他们是今天波利尼西亚人的远祖。

10.en: The Lapita left precious few clues about themselves, but Efate expands the volume of data available to researchers dramatically.
parts: 拉皮塔人留下的有关自身的线索少之又少，但埃法特岛的发现大大增加了研究者可用的资料。

13.en: ‘It’s an important discovery’, says Matthew Spriggs, professor of archaeology at the Australian National University and head of the international team digging up the site, ‘for it conclusively identifies the remains as Lapita.’
parts: “这是一项重要的发现，”马修·斯普里格斯说。
他是澳大利亚国立大学考古学教授，也是发掘这一遗址的国际团队负责人。
“因为这确凿地表明，这些遗骸属于拉皮塔人。”

17.en: There is one stubborn question for which archaeology has yet to provide any answers: how did the Lapita accomplish the ancient equivalent of a moon landing, many times over?
parts: 有一道难题，考古学至今还没能给出答案：拉皮塔人如何一次又一次完成了在古代堪比登月的壮举？

21.en: Those sailing skills, he says, were developed and passed down over thousands of years by earlier mariners who worked their way through the archipelagoes of the western Pacific, making short crossings to nearby islands.
parts: 他说，这些航海技能是更早的航海者历经数千年发展并传承下来的。
他们在西太平洋的各个群岛间逐步前行，每次短途航行到附近的岛屿。

29.en: Once out there, skilled seafarers would have detected abundant leads to follow to land: seabirds, coconuts and twigs carried out to sea by the tides, and the afternoon pile-up of clouds on the horizon which often indicates an island in the distance.
parts: 到了海上，有经验的航海者想必会发现许多能引导他们找到陆地的线索：
海鸟，被潮水带到海上的椰子和小树枝，
以及午后堆聚在地平线上的云团——云团往往预示着远处有岛。

32.en: Vanuatu, for example, stretches more than 500 miles in a northwest-southeast trend, its scores of intervisible islands forming a backstop for mariners riding the trade winds home.
parts: 以瓦努阿图为例，群岛沿西北至东南方向绵延五百多英里。
几十座彼此可以望见的岛屿，给乘信风返乡的航海者提供了最后一道保障。

38.en: El Niño, the same climate disruption that affects the Pacific today, may have helped scatter the Lapita, Anderson suggests.
parts: 安德森认为，如今仍影响太平洋的厄尔尼诺气候异常现象，当年可能也促使拉皮塔人分散到了各地。

40.en: By reversing the regular east-to-west flow of the trade winds for weeks at a time, these ‘super El Niños’ might have taken the Lapita on long unplanned voyages.
parts: 这些“超级厄尔尼诺”现象每次都使通常自东向西吹的信风反向持续数周，可能就这样把拉皮塔人带上了原本未曾计划的长途航程。

43.en: They probably never numbered more than a few thousand in total, and in their rapid migration eastward they encountered hundreds of islands - more than 300 in Fiji alone.
parts: 他们的总人数很可能从未超过几千人，
却在迅速东迁途中遇到数百座岛屿，单是斐济就有三百多座。

12.en: Other items included a Lapita burial urn with modeled birds arranged on the rim as though peering down at the human remains sealed inside.
parts: 其他出土物还包括一件拉皮塔葬瓮，瓮口边缘排列着塑成鸟形的装饰，
看起来仿佛正低头细看封存在瓮里的遗骸。

27.en: ‘They could sail out for days into the unknown and assess the area, secure in the knowledge that if they didn’t find anything, they could turn about and catch a swift ride back on the trade winds.
parts: “他们可以驶向未知海域，连续航行数天，探察那一带。
他们心里有底：即使一无所获，也可以掉头，借着信风迅速返航。

1.en: Ancient voyagers who settled the far-flung islands of the Pacific Ocean
parts: 在太平洋遥远岛屿上定居的古代航海者

3.en: The site came to light only by chance.
parts: 这处遗址纯属偶然才被发现。

4.en: An agricultural worker, digging in the grounds of a derelict plantation, scraped open a grave—the first of dozens in a burial ground some 3,000 years old.
parts: 一名农工在一处废弃种植园里挖土，刨开了一座坟墓。这是人们在一片距今约三千年的墓地中发现的数十座坟墓里的第一座。

5.en: It is the oldest cemetery ever found in the Pacific islands, and it harbors the remains of an ancient people archaeologists call the Lapita.
parts: 这是迄今在太平洋诸岛发现的最古老的墓地，里面葬着一个古老族群的遗骸。考古学家称他们为拉皮塔人。

6.en: They were daring blue-water adventurers who used basic canoes to rove across the ocean.
parts: 他们是敢于闯荡远洋的冒险者，驾着简陋的独木舟漂洋过海。

7.en: But they were not just explorers.
parts: 但他们不只是探险者。

8.en: They were also pioneers who carried with them everything they would need to build new lives—their livestock, taro seedlings and stone tools.
parts: 他们也是开拓者，随身带着开始新生活所需的一切——牲畜、芋头幼苗和石器。

9.en: Within the span of several centuries, the Lapita stretched the boundaries of their world from the jungle-clad volcanoes of Papua New Guinea to the loneliest coral outliers of Tonga.
parts: 几个世纪里，拉皮塔人的足迹从巴布亚新几内亚丛林覆盖的火山，一直延伸到汤加最偏远的珊瑚岛。

11.en: The remains of 62 individuals have been uncovered so far, and archaeologists were also thrilled to find six complete Lapita pots.
parts: 迄今已出土62人的遗骸。令考古学家兴奋的还有六件完整的拉皮塔陶罐。

14.en: DNA teased from these human remains may help answer one of the most puzzling questions in Pacific anthropology: did all Pacific islanders spring from one source or many?
parts: 从这些遗骸中提取的DNA，或许有助于解开太平洋人类学中一个极为棘手的问题：所有太平洋岛民究竟是同源，还是有多个来源？

15.en: Was there only one outward migration from a single point in Asia, or several from different points?
parts: 向外迁徙是否只有一次，起点在亚洲的某一处？还是有过多次迁徙，各自从不同地点出发？

16.en: ‘This represents the best opportunity we’ve had yet,’ says Spriggs, ‘to find out who the Lapita actually were, where they came from, and who their closest descendants are today.’
parts: 斯普里格斯说：“这是我们迄今最好的机会，可以弄清拉皮塔人究竟是谁、来自哪里，以及今天哪些人是与他们血缘最近的后裔。”

18.en: No-one has found one of their canoes or any rigging, which could reveal how the canoes were sailed.
parts: 至今没有人找到过他们的任何一艘独木舟，也没有找到过任何帆索具，而这些实物本可以揭示他们是怎样驾舟航行的。

19.en: Nor do the oral histories and traditions of later Polynesians offer any insights, for they turn into myths long before they reach as far back in time as the Lapita.
parts: 后世波利尼西亚人的口述历史和传统也没有提供线索，因为沿着这些叙事向前追溯，远未及拉皮塔人的时代，它们就已变成了神话。
terms: reach as far back in time as
reach as far back in time as

20.en: ‘All we can say for certain is that the Lapita had canoes that were capable of ocean voyages, and they had the ability to sail them,’ says Geoff Irwin, a professor of archaeology at the University of Auckland.
parts: “我们唯一能确定的是，拉皮塔人拥有能远洋航行的独木舟，也有本领驾驶它们。”奥克兰大学考古学教授杰夫·欧文说。
terms: All we can say for certain
all we can say for certain

22.en: The real adventure didn’t begin, however, until their Lapita descendants sailed out of sight of land, with empty horizons on every side.
parts: 然而，直到他们的后裔拉皮塔人航行到看不见陆地、四面海天茫茫的地方，真正的冒险才开始。

23.en: This must have been as difficult for them as landing on the moon is for us today.
parts: 对他们来说，这想必和今天我们登月一样困难。

24.en: Certainly it distinguished them from their ancestors, but what gave them the courage to launch out on such risky voyages?
parts: 这当然使他们有别于祖先。可是，是什么给了他们勇气，踏上如此冒险的航程？

25.en: The Lapita’s thrust into the Pacific was eastward, against the prevailing trade winds, Irwin notes.
parts: 欧文指出，拉皮塔人向东挺进太平洋，迎着当地盛行的信风航行。

26.en: Those nagging headwinds, he argues, may have been the key to their success.
parts: 他认为，那些一直让人头疼的逆风可能恰恰是他们成功的关键。

28.en: This is what would have made the whole thing work.’
parts: 正是这一点，才可能让整个办法行得通。”

30.en: For returning explorers successful or not, the geography of their own archipelagoes would have provided a safety net.
parts: 探险者归航时，无论此行有无收获，家乡群岛的地理格局想必都能给他们提供一道保障。

31.en: Without this to go by, overshooting their home ports, getting lost and sailing off into eternity would have been all too easy.
parts: 若没有这样的地理格局作为参照，他们就很容易驶过自己的港口，迷失方向，从此一去不返。
terms: 驶入茫茫大海，一去不返

33.en: All this presupposes one essential detail, says Atholl Anderson, professor of prehistory at the Australian National University: the Lapita had mastered the advanced art of sailing against the wind.
parts: 澳大利亚国立大学史前学教授阿索尔·安德森指出，这一切都有一个必要前提：拉皮塔人已经掌握了逆风航行的高超技艺。

34.en: ‘And there’s no proof they could do any such thing,’ Anderson says.
parts: “可我们并没有证据表明他们有这样的本领。”安德森说。

35.en: ‘There has been this assumption they did, and people have built canoes to re-create those early voyages based on that assumption.
parts: “人们一直假定他们具备这种能力，还依据这个假定建造独木舟，重现当年的那些航程。

36.en: But nobody has any idea what their canoes looked like or how they were rigged.’
parts: 但是，没人知道他们的独木舟是什么样子，也不知道船上的帆索具是怎样配置的。”

37.en: Rather than give all the credit to human skill, Anderson invokes the winds of chance.
parts: 安德森没有把全部功劳都归给人的航海技艺。他还提出，风向上的偶然变化也可能起了作用。

41.en: However they did it, the Lapita spread themselves a third of the way across the Pacific, then called it quits for reasons known only to them.
parts: 不管拉皮塔人是怎样做到的，他们向前迁徙了横跨太平洋全程的三分之一，便就此止步。为什么停下，只有他们自己知道。
terms: for reasons known only to them
for reasons known only to them
原因只有他们自己知道

42.en: Ahead lay the vast emptiness of the central Pacific and perhaps they were too thinly stretched to venture farther.
parts: 前方是中太平洋辽阔空旷的海域，或许他们的人手已经分散得太开，无法再向更远处探航。

7.en: This all amounts to heightened activity and noise levels, which have the potential to be particularly serious for children experiencing auditory function deficit.
parts: 这些都意味着课堂活动增多，噪声水平升高。
对听觉功能有障碍的儿童来说，这种情况可能尤其严重。

39.en: It is imperative that the needs of these children are taken into account in the setting of appropriate international standards to be promulgated in future.
parts: 在制定日后将颁布的相关国际标准时，务必考虑这些儿童的需要。

26.en: These levels come from outside activities that penetrate the classroom structure, from teaching activities, and other noise generated inside, which can be exacerbated by room reverberation.
parts: 这些噪声来自穿过教室围护结构传入的室外活动声，也来自教学活动和室内产生的其他声音。
室内的混响还会使噪声加剧。

27.en: Strategies are needed to obtain the optimum classroom construction and perhaps a change in classroom culture and methods of teaching.
parts: 需要采取措施，把教室建得尽可能适合教学。课堂文化和教学方法或许也需要改变。

5.en: Modern teaching practices, the organisation of desks in the classroom, poor classroom acoustics, and mechanical means of ventilation such as air-conditioning units all contribute to the number of children unable to comprehend the teacher’s voice.
parts: 现代教学方式、课桌的摆放、不良的教室声学环境，以及空调等机械通风设备，
都会使更多儿童听不懂老师说的话。

6.en: Education researchers Nelson and Soli have also suggested that recent trends in learning often involve collaborative interaction of multiple minds and tools as much as individual possession of information.
parts: 教育研究者纳尔逊和索利还提出，近年的学习往往既涉及多人和多种工具之间的协作互动，
也同样涉及个人对信息的掌握。
terms: 多人的思考与多种工具

8.en: Noise in classrooms can only exacerbate their difficulty in comprehending and processing verbal communication with other children and instructions from the teacher.
parts: 教室里的噪声只会让这些儿童更难理解和处理两类口头信息：他们与其他儿童交流时听到的话，以及老师的指令。

11.en: The International Institute of Noise Control Engineering (I-INCE), on the advice of the World Health Organization, has established an international working party, which includes New Zealand, to evaluate noise and reverberation control for school rooms.
parts: 国际噪声控制工程学会（I-INCE）根据世界卫生组织的建议，成立了一个有新西兰参与的国际工作组，
负责评估学校教室的噪声与混响控制。

12.en: While the detrimental effects of noise in classroom situations are not limited to children experiencing disability, those with a disability that affects their processing of speech and verbal communication could be extremely vulnerable.
parts: 课堂噪声的不良影响并不限于有障碍的儿童，
不过，如果某种障碍影响到儿童处理言语和口头交流信息的能力，他们就可能尤其容易受到噪声的伤害。

22.en: The attention deficit disorders are indicative of neurological and genetic disorders and are characterised by difficulties with sustaining attention, effort and persistence, organisation skills and disinhibition.
parts: 注意缺陷类障碍是神经和遗传方面异常的表现。
其特征包括难以持续集中注意、保持努力并坚持做事，组织能力较弱，也难以抑制冲动。

25.en: Children experiencing an auditory function deficit can often find speech and communication very difficult to isolate and process when set against high levels of background noise.
parts: 在背景噪声很强时，听觉功能有障碍的儿童往往很难单独辨别出言语和交流信息并加以处理。

32.en: The strategy recognises that people experiencing disability face significant barriers in achieving a full quality of life in areas such as attitude, education, employment and access to services.
parts: 这一战略承认，有障碍的人若要充分享有优质生活，面临着重重阻碍，
涉及社会态度、教育、就业和获取服务等方面。

33.en: Objective 3 of the New Zealand Disability Strategy is to ‘Provide the Best Education for Disabled People’ by improving education so that all children, youth learners and adult learners will have equal opportunities to learn and develop within their already existing local school.
parts: 《新西兰残障战略》的第三项目标是“为残障人士提供最好的教育”。
为此要改善教育，使所有儿童、青年和成人学习者都能在当地现有学校平等地获得学习和发展的机会。

34.en: For a successful education, the learning environment is vitally significant, so any effort to improve this is likely to be of great benefit to all children, but especially to those with auditory function disabilities.
parts: 学习环境对教育能否成功至关重要。因此，为改善环境所作的任何努力都很可能让所有儿童大为受益，
听觉功能有障碍的儿童尤其如此。

38.en: Only limited attention appears to have been given to those students experiencing the other disabilities involving auditory function deficit.
parts: 至于那些有其他障碍、且障碍涉及听觉功能的学生，他们受到的关注似乎相当有限。

1.en: Hearing impairment or other auditory function deficit in young children can have a major impact on their development of speech and communication, resulting in a detrimental effect on their ability to learn at school.
parts: 幼儿听力受损或存在其他听觉功能障碍，可能会严重影响其言语和沟通能力的发展，
进而不利于他们在学校学习。

2.en: This is likely to have major consequences for the individual and the population as a whole.
parts: 这很可能对个人乃至整个人群都产生重大影响。

3.en: The New Zealand Ministry of Health has found from research carried out over two decades that 6-10% of children in that country are affected by hearing loss.
parts: 新西兰卫生部根据历时二十年的研究发现，该国有6%至10%的儿童受到听力损失的影响。

4.en: A preliminary study in New Zealand has shown that classroom noise presents a major concern for teachers and pupils.
parts: 新西兰的一项初步研究表明，教室噪声是教师和学生都很担心的问题。

9.en: Children with auditory function deficit are potentially failing to learn to their maximum potential because of noise levels generated in classrooms.
parts: 由于教室里的噪声，听觉功能有障碍的孩子在学习时可能无法充分发挥潜能。

10.en: The effects of noise on the ability of children to learn effectively in typical classroom environments are now the subject of increasing concern.
parts: 在普通教室里，噪声如何影响儿童有效学习的能力，如今正受到越来越多的关注。

13.en: The auditory function deficits in question include hearing impairment, autistic spectrum disorders (ASD) and attention deficit disorders (ADD/ADHD).
parts: 这里所说的听觉功能障碍包括听力受损、自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）和注意缺陷障碍（ADD/ADHD）。

14.en: Autism is considered a neurological and genetic life-long disorder that causes discrepancies in the way information is processed.
parts: 自闭症被认为是一种与神经系统和遗传有关的终身障碍，会造成信息处理方式上的差异。

15.en: This disorder is characterised by interlinking problems with social imagination, social communication and social interaction.
parts: 这种障碍的特点是，在社交想象、社交沟通和社会互动方面存在彼此关联的困难。

16.en: According to Janzen, this affects the ability to understand and relate in typical ways to people, understand events and objects in the environment, and understand or respond to sensory stimuli.
parts: 詹岑指出，这会影响他们以通常的方式理解他人、与人交往的能力，也会影响他们理解周围事物，以及理解或回应感官刺激的能力。

17.en: Autism does not allow learning or thinking in the same ways as in children who are developing normally.
parts: 自闭症使这些儿童无法以与发育正常的儿童相同的方式学习或思考。

18.en: Autistic spectrum disorders often result in major difficulties in comprehending verbal information and speech processing.
parts: 自闭症谱系障碍常使人在理解口头信息和处理言语信息时遇到很大困难。

19.en: Those experiencing these disorders often find sounds such as crowd noise and the noise generated by machinery painful and distressing.
parts: 有这些障碍的人常觉得人群的嘈杂声、机器发出的噪声等声音令人痛苦不安。

20.en: This is difficult to scientifically quantify as such extra-sensory stimuli vary greatly from one autistic individual to another.
parts: 这种感受很难用科学方法量化，因为不同自闭症人士所感受到的这类额外感官刺激差异很大。
terms: from one autistic individual to another
from one autistic individual to another

21.en: But a child who finds any type of noise in their classroom or learning space intrusive is likely to be adversely affected in their ability to process information.
parts: 不过，如果孩子觉得教室或学习场所里的某种噪声干扰了自己，其处理信息的能力就很可能受到不利影响。

23.en: Children experiencing these disorders find it difficult to screen out unimportant information, and focus on everything in the environment rather than attending to a single activity.
parts: 有这些障碍的儿童很难过滤掉无关信息。他们的注意力会落在周围的所有事物上，很难集中在单一活动上。

24.en: Background noise in the classroom becomes a major distraction, which can affect their ability to concentrate.
parts: 教室里的背景噪声会严重分散他们的注意力，使他们难以专心。
terms: 严重干扰注意力的因素

28.en: In particular, the effects of noisy classrooms and activities on those experiencing disabilities in the form of auditory function deficit need thorough investigation.
parts: 尤其需要深入研究的是，嘈杂的教室和课堂活动会怎样影响有听觉功能障碍的人。

29.en: It is probable that many undiagnosed children exist in the education system with ‘invisible’ disabilities.
parts: 学校里很可能有许多儿童带有“看不见的”障碍，却一直未获诊断。

30.en: Their needs are less likely to be met than those of children with known disabilities.
parts: 与障碍已经得到确认的儿童相比，这些儿童的需要较难得到满足。

31.en: The New Zealand Government has developed a New Zealand Disability Strategy and has embarked on a wide-ranging consultation process.
parts: 新西兰政府已制定《新西兰残障战略》，并已开始广泛征求意见。

35.en: A number of countries are already in the process of formulating their own standards for the control and reduction of classroom noise.
parts: 好些国家已经着手制定本国标准，以控制并降低教室噪声。

36.en: New Zealand will probably follow their example.
parts: 新西兰很可能也会效仿这些国家。

37.en: The literature to date on noise in school rooms appears to focus on the effects on schoolchildren in general, their teachers and the hearing impaired.
parts: 迄今为止，有关教室噪声的文献似乎主要关注它对一般学生、他们的教师以及听障人士的影响。

27.en: “Although the image of the good worker is the one whose life belongs to the company,” Bailyn says, “it doesn’t fit the facts.”
parts: “人们心目中的好员工，整个人生都属于公司，”贝林说，“可这种形象与事实并不相符。”

28.en: She cites both quantitative and qualitative studies that show increased productivity for part-time workers: they make better use of the time they have and they are less likely to succumb to fatigue in stressful jobs.
parts: 她援引了定量和定性两类研究，这些研究都表明，兼职员工的工作效率有所提高。
他们更能充分利用工作时间，在压力大的岗位上也较少会因疲劳而撑不住。

29.en: Companies that employ more workers for less time also gain from the resulting redundancy, she asserts.
parts: 她断言，企业多雇一些员工，让每人少工作一些时间，还能从由此形成的人员余量中获益。

1.en: For the first century or so of the industrial revolution, increased productivity led to decreases in working hours.
parts: 在工业革命开始后大约一个世纪的时间里，生产率的提高带来了工作时间的缩短。

18.en: Diminishing returns may eventually set in as overworked employees lose efficiency or leave for more arable pastures.
parts: 员工工作过度，效率会下降，也有人会另谋更好的出路。这样一来，边际收益最终可能开始递减。

37.en: As Schor notes, the situation is a curious inversion of the “appropriate technology” vision that designers have had for developing countries: U.S. goods are appropriate only for high incomes and long hours.
parts: 正如肖尔所说，这种局面颇为奇特：它把设计者为发展中国家设想的“适用技术”理念颠倒了过来。
美国的商品只适合收入高、工作时间长的人。

10.en: Since 1979, companies have responded to improvements in the business climate by having employees work overtime rather than by hiring extra personnel, says economist Juliet B. Schor of Harvard University.
parts: 自1979年以来，商业环境好转时，企业的应对方式一直是让员工加班，而非增聘人手。
这是哈佛大学经济学家朱丽叶·B·肖尔的观察。

23.en: “People who work reduced hours pay a huge penalty in career terms,” Schor maintains.
parts: “缩短工作时间的人会在职业发展上付出很大的代价，”肖尔坚持认为。

25.en: [Lotte] Bailyn [of Massachusetts Institute of Technology] adds that many corporate managers find it difficult to measure the contribution of their underlings to a firm’s well-being, so they use the number of hours worked as a proxy for output.
parts: 麻省理工学院的洛特·贝林补充说，许多企业管理者觉得，很难衡量下属对企业良好经营所作的贡献，
于是就用工时来间接衡量产出。

33.en: It may take even more than changes in the financial and cultural structures of employment for workers successfully to trade increased productivity and money for leisure time, Schor contends.
parts: 肖尔认为，劳动者若想把更高的生产率和收入换成闲暇时间，光改变就业制度的经济结构和文化结构可能还不够。

7.en: In fact, working hours have increased noticeably since 1970 — perhaps because real wages have stagnated since that year.
parts: 事实上，从1970年起，工时明显延长了——这或许是因为实际工资从那一年起就停滞不前。

9.en: There are several reasons for lost leisure.
parts: 人们的闲暇时间减少，有好几个原因。

34.en: She says the U.S. market for goods has become skewed by the assumption of full-time, two-career households.
parts: 她说，美国商品市场出现了偏差，因为它把双方都全职工作的双职工家庭视为常态。

35.en: Automobile makers no longer manufacture cheap models, and developers do not build the tiny bungalows that served the first postwar generation of home buyers.
parts: 汽车制造商已经不再生产廉价车型，房地产开发商也不再建造那种曾满足战后第一代购房者需求的小平房。

31.en: The motion of a pendulum rocks this device so that it catches and then releases each tooth of the escape wheel, in turn allowing it to turn a precise amount.
parts: 钟摆的运动带动这一装置来回摆动，使它逐齿卡住擒纵轮的轮齿再放开，
从而使擒纵轮每次都恰好转过一定的角度。

1.en: Our conception of time depends on the way we measure it
parts: 我们怎样理解时间，取决于我们怎样衡量时间。

37.en: So integral have these time-based technologies become to day-to-day existence that our dependency on them is recognised only when they fail to work.
parts: 这些基于计时的技术与日常生活已经密不可分，以至于只有当它们失灵时，我们才意识到自己有多依赖它们。

2.en: According to archaeological evidence, at least 5,000 years ago, and long before the advent of the Roman Empire, the Babylonians began to measure time, introducing calendars to co-ordinate communal activities, to plan the shipment of goods and, in particular, to regulate planting and harvesting.
parts: 考古证据表明，至少在五千年前，远在罗马帝国出现之前，巴比伦人就开始计时了。
他们引入历法，以协调集体活动、安排货运，尤其是确定播种和收获的时间。

6.en: Hence, the calendars that were developed at the lower latitudes were influenced more by the lunar cycle than by the solar year.
parts: 因此，在较低纬度地区形成的历法受月相周期的影响，比受太阳年的影响更大。

9.en: Centuries before the Roman Empire, the Egyptians had formulated a municipal calendar having 12 months of 30 days, with five days added to approximate the solar year.
parts: 早在罗马帝国出现前几个世纪，埃及人就制定了民用历法：一年十二个月，每月三十天，另加五天，使一年的天数接近太阳年。

10.en: Each period of ten days was marked by the appearance of special groups of stars called decans.
parts: 每隔十天，就有一组特定的恒星出现，标志着新的一旬开始。这些星群称为“旬星”。

11.en: At the rise of the star Sirius just before sunrise, which occurred around the all-important annual flooding of the Nile, 12 decans could be seen spanning the heavens.
parts: 天狼星在日出前夕升起，这一现象大致出现在每年那场至关重要的尼罗河泛滥前后。
此时可以看到十二组旬星横跨天空。

12.en: The cosmic significance the Egyptians placed in the 12 decans led them to develop a system in which each interval of darkness （and later, each interval of daylight） was divided into a dozen equal parts.
parts: 埃及人赋予这十二组旬星以宇宙层面的意义，于是创立了一种计时制度：
每段黑夜都被等分为十二份，后来每段白昼也作同样的划分。

13.en: These periods became known as temporal hours because their duration varied according to the changing length of days and nights with the passing of the seasons.
parts: 这些计时单位被称为“不等时”，因为随着季节交替和昼夜长短的变化，每一时段的时长也会改变。

15.en: Temporal hours, which were first adopted by the Greeks and then the Romans, who disseminated them through Europe, remained in use for more than 2,500 years.
parts: 不等时制最初由希腊人采用，后来罗马人也采用了它，并将它传遍欧洲。这种计时方法沿用了两千五百多年。

16.en: In order to track temporal hours during the day, inventors created sundials, which indicate time by the length or direction of the sun’s shadow.
parts: 为在白天测定不等时，发明者制作了日晷，利用日影的长度或方向指示时间。

17.en: The sundial’s counterpart, the water clock, was designed to measure temporal hours at night.
parts: 与日晷相对应的是水钟，它是为在夜间测定不等时而设计的。

23.en: The schemes that divided the day into 24 equal parts varied according to the start of the count: Italian hours began at sunset, Babylonian hours at sunrise, astronomical hours at midday and ‘great clock’ hours, used for some large public clocks in Germany, at midnight.
parts: 一天都分为二十四等份，但各套制度的起算时刻不同：
意大利时从日落算起，巴比伦时从日出算起，天文时从正午算起，
而德国某些大型公共时钟采用的“大钟时”则从午夜算起。

26.en: The revolutionary aspect of this new timekeeper was neither the descending weight that provided its motive force nor the gear wheels （which had been around for at least 1,300 years） that transferred the power; it was the part called the escapement.
parts: 这种新计时器的革命性之处，既不在于提供动力的下落重锤，
也不在于传递动力的齿轮（齿轮当时至少已有一千三百年的历史），
而在于那个叫作“擒纵机构”的部件。

32.en: Unlike the original form used in early pendulum clocks, the anchor escapement permitted the pendulum to travel in a very small arc.
parts: 与早期摆钟采用的原始结构不同，锚式擒纵机构使钟摆得以沿很小的圆弧摆动。

35.en: Nearly all computers contain a quartz-crystal clock to regulate their operation.
parts: 几乎所有计算机都装有石英晶体时钟，用于调控计算机的运行。

36.en: Moreover, not only do time signals beamed down from Global Positioning System satellites calibrate the functions of precision navigation equipment, they do so as well for mobile phones, instant stock-trading systems and nationwide power-distribution grids.
parts: 此外，全球定位系统卫星向地面发射的时间信号，不仅用来校准精密导航设备，
也用来校准手机、即时股票交易系统和全国配电网络的运行。

14.en: Summer hours were long, winter ones short; only at the spring and autumn equinoxes were the hours of daylight and darkness equal.
parts: 白昼的一小时在夏季较长，冬季较短。只有在春分和秋分，白昼与黑夜的一小时才等长。

21.en: The advent of the mechanical clock meant that although it could be adjusted to maintain temporal hours, it was naturally suited to keeping equal ones.
parts: 机械钟问世后，虽然可以调整它来计不等时，但它本身更适合按等长的小时计时。

24.en: Eventually these were superseded by ‘small clock’, or French, hours, which split the day into two 12-hour periods commencing at midnight.
parts: 这些制度最终被“小钟时”（又称法国时制）取代。这种时制从午夜起算，把一天分为两个十二小时的时段。

33.en: Moreover, this invention allowed the use of a long pendulum which could beat once a second and thus led to the development of a new floor-standing case design, which became known as the grandfather clock.
parts: 此外，这项发明让人们可以使用每秒摆动一下的长摆，
也由此催生出一种采用落地式钟壳的新设计，后来人们称这种钟为“落地大摆钟”。

3.en: They based their calendars on three natural cycles: the solar day, marked by the successive periods of light and darkness as the earth rotates on its axis; the lunar month, following the phases of the moon as it orbits the earth; and the solar year, defined by the changing seasons that accompany our planet’s revolution around the sun.
parts: 他们依据三个自然周期制定历法：第一个是太阳日，以地球自转时昼夜交替为标志；
第二个是朔望月，依据月球绕地球运行时的月相变化；
第三个是太阳年，以地球绕太阳公转时四季的更替来界定。

4.en: Before the invention of artificial light, the moon had greater social impact.
parts: 在人造照明发明之前，月亮对社会生活的影响更大。

5.en: And, for those living near the equator in particular, its waxing and waning was more conspicuous than the passing of the seasons.
parts: 尤其对赤道附近的居民而言，月亮的盈亏比四季更迭更为显眼。

7.en: In more northern climes, however, where seasonal agriculture was practised, the solar year became more crucial.
parts: 不过，在更偏北的地区，农业生产随季节进行，太阳年因此更为重要。
terms: 随季节进行的农业生产

8.en: As the Roman Empire expanded northward, it organised its activity chart for the most part around the solar year.
parts: 随着罗马帝国向北扩张，它大体上按照太阳年来安排各项活动。

18.en: One of the first water clocks was a basin with a small hole near the bottom through which the water dripped out.
parts: 早期水钟中有一种是个盆，靠近盆底的地方开有小孔，水从孔中滴出。

19.en: The falling water level denoted the passing hour as it dipped below hour lines inscribed on the inner surface.
parts: 水位逐渐下降，每低过内壁上的一条小时刻线，就表示又过了一小时。

20.en: Although these devices performed satisfactorily around the Mediterranean, they could not always be depended on in the cloudy and often freezing weather of northern Europe.
parts: 这些计时工具在地中海一带效果不错，但到了欧洲北部，天气多云又时常冰冻，它们就未必总靠得住了。

22.en: With these, however, arose the question of when to begin counting, and so, in the early 14th century, a number of systems evolved.
parts: 然而，有了这些等长的小时，究竟从何时起算就成了问题。于是，14世纪初逐渐形成了几种不同的计时制度。

25.en: The earliest recorded weight-driven mechanical clock was built in 1283 in Bedfordshire in England.
parts: 有记载的最早一座重锤驱动机械钟于1283年在英格兰贝德福德郡制成。

27.en: In the early 1400s came the invention of the coiled spring or fusee which maintained constant force to the gear wheels of the timekeeper despite the changing tension of its mainspring.
parts: 15世纪初，人们发明了盘簧或均力塔轮。
即使主发条的张力发生变化，这种装置也能让计时器的齿轮获得恒定的驱动力。

28.en: By the 16th century, a pendulum clock had been devised, but the pendulum swung in a large arc and thus was not very efficient.
parts: 到16世纪，摆钟已经问世，但钟摆摆动的弧度很大，因而效率不高。

29.en: To address this, a variation on the original escapement was invented in 1670, in England.
parts: 为解决这个问题，1670年，英格兰有人在原有擒纵机构的基础上发明了一种变体。

30.en: It was called the anchor escapement, which was a lever-based device shaped like a ship’s anchor.
parts: 它被称为锚式擒纵机构，是一种利用杠杆工作的装置，形状像船锚。

34.en: Today, highly accurate timekeeping instruments set the beat for most electronic devices.
parts: 如今，大多数电子设备的工作节奏都由高精度计时仪器控制。

2.en: And yet most of us have had the experience of having to adjust to sleeping in the mountains or the countryside because it was initially ‘too quiet’, an experience that suggests that humans are capable of adapting to a wide range of noise levels.
parts: 可我们大多有过这样的经历：在山区或乡下睡觉，一开始觉得“太安静”，得花些时间适应。
这表明人能适应相差很大的噪声水平。

8.en: For example, high noise levels interfered with the performance of subjects who were required to monitor three dials at a time, a task not unlike that of an aeroplane pilot or an air-traffic controller (Broadbent, 1957).
parts: 例如，受试者需要同时监看三个仪表盘时，强噪声会影响他们的表现。
这项任务颇似飞行员或空中交通管制员的工作（布罗德本特，1957年）。

9.en: Similarly, noise did not affect a subject’s ability to track a moving line with a steering wheel, but it did interfere with the subject’s ability to repeat numbers while tracking (Finkelman and Glass, 1970).
parts: 同样，噪声并不影响受试者用方向盘追踪移动线条的能力，
但如果要一边追踪一边复述数字，噪声确实会干扰他们复述数字的能力（芬克尔曼和格拉斯，1970年）。

13.en: For some subjects, the bursts were spaced exactly one minute apart (predictable noise); others heard the same amount of noise overall, but the bursts occurred at random intervals (unpredictable noise).
parts: 有些受试者听到的一阵阵噪声恰好相隔一分钟（可预测噪声）。
另一些人听到的噪声总量相同，但各阵噪声之间的间隔是随机的（不可预测噪声）。

25.en: One study, suggesting that this worry is a realistic one, compared elementary school pupils who attended schools near Los Angeles’s busiest airport with students who attended schools in quiet neighbourhoods (Cohen et al., 1980).
parts: 一项研究表明，这种担忧确有根据。研究者比较了两组小学生：
一组在洛杉矶最繁忙的机场附近上学，另一组在安静的街区上学（科恩等，1980年）。

1.en: In general, it is plausible to suppose that we should prefer peace and quiet to noise.
parts: 一般说来，有理由认为，相比噪声，我们更喜欢平静安宁。

11.en: We are much more able to ‘tune out’ chronic background noise, even if it is quite loud, than to work under circumstances with unexpected intrusions of noise.
parts: 持续的背景噪声，即使相当响，我们也比较容易把它“屏蔽”掉。
相比之下，要在不时受到突发噪声干扰的环境中工作，就难得多了。

12.en: In the Glass and Singer study, in which subjects were exposed to bursts of noise as they worked on a task, some subjects heard loud bursts and others heard soft bursts.
parts: 在格拉斯和辛格的研究中，受试者在完成任务时听到一阵阵噪声。
有些人听到的噪声很响，有些人听到的则很轻。

20.en: If the individual knows that he or she can control the noise, this seems to eliminate both its negative effects at the time and its after-effects.
parts: 如果一个人知道自己能够控制噪声，那么，噪声当时的不利影响和事后的影响似乎都会消失。

26.en: It was found that children from the noisy schools had higher blood pressure and were more easily distracted than those who attended the quiet schools.
parts: 研究发现，与在安静学校上学的儿童相比，在嘈杂学校上学的儿童血压更高，也更容易分心。

7.en: But there are limits to adaptation and loud noise becomes more troublesome if the person is required to concentrate on more than one task.
parts: 不过，人的适应能力有限。如果一个人需要同时专注于不止一项任务，响亮的噪声就会更扰人。

7.en: The topics discussed included the co-ordinated study of the destruction of forests, as well as how to combat forest fires and the extension of European research programs on the forest ecosystem.
parts: 会上讨论的议题包括协同研究森林破坏问题，
也包括如何扑救森林火灾，以及扩大欧洲的森林生态系统研究计划。

15.en: Finally, they offer those condemned to spend five days a week in an urban environment an unrivalled area of freedom to unwind and take part in a range of leisure activities, such as hunting, riding and hiking.
parts: 最后，对那些每周有五天不得不待在城市里的人来说，森林提供了一处无可比拟的自由天地，
让他们放松身心，参加打猎、骑马、徒步等各种休闲活动。

21.en: This means that a forest policy is vital, that it must transcend national frontiers and generations of people, and that it must allow for the inevitable changes that take place in the forests, in needs, and hence in policy.
parts: 这意味着森林政策至关重要。它必须超越国界，跨越世代，
还必须考虑到森林本身和人们的需求不可避免地会改变，政策也因此会随之改变。

13.en: The first is to act as a ‘green lung’ for our planet; by means of photosynthesis, forests produce oxygen through the transformation of solar energy, thus fulfilling what for humans is the essential role of an immense, non-polluting power plant.
parts: 第一项作用是充当地球的“绿肺”。
森林通过光合作用转化太阳能，产生氧气。
这样，森林就像一座庞大而无污染的发电厂，发挥着对人类不可或缺的作用。

23.en: A general declaration was made that ‘a central place in any ecologically coherent forest policy must be given to continuity over time and to the possible effects of unforeseen events, to ensure that the full potential of these forests is maintained’.
parts: 会议发表了一项总声明，指出：“任何符合生态规律的森林政策，都必须把长期的连续性放在核心位置，
也必须同样重视意外事件可能产生的影响，以确保这些森林的全部潜力得以保持。”

37.en: A thinly scattered permanent population and development of leisure activities, particularly skiing, have resulted in significant long-term changes to the local ecosystems.
parts: 当地常住人口分布稀疏，休闲活动也有所发展，尤以滑雪为甚。
这两点使当地生态系统发生了显著而持久的变化。

3.en: European countries are becoming increasingly concerned by major threats to European forests, threats which know no frontiers other than those of geography or climate: air pollution, soil deterioration, the increasing number of forest fires and sometimes even the mismanagement of our woodland and forest heritage.
parts: 欧洲各国越来越担忧欧洲森林面临的重大威胁。
这些威胁只受地理或气候条件的限制：
空气污染、土壤退化、森林火灾日益增多，有时甚至还包括人们对林地与森林遗产管理不善。

16.en: The economic importance of forests has been understood since the dawn of man - wood was the first fuel.
parts: 自人类出现之初，人们就已认识到森林的经济价值——木材是人类最早使用的燃料。

27.en: The entire continent and the majority of species are now affected: between 30% and 50% of the tree population.
parts: 如今，全欧洲和大多数树种都受到波及，受影响的树木占总数的30%至50%。

46.en: Their final text commits them to on-going discussion between government representatives with responsibility for forests.
parts: 会议的最终文件要求与会各方作出承诺，让各国主管森林事务的政府代表持续开展对话。

3.en: ‘The glass industry is aware of the issue,’ says Brian Waldron, chairman of the standards committee at the Glass and Glazing Federation, a British trade association, and standards development officer at Pilkington.
parts: “玻璃行业知道这个问题，”布赖恩·沃尔德伦说。
他是英国行业协会玻璃与装配玻璃联合会标准委员会主席，同时也是皮尔金顿公司的标准制定专员。
terms: 玻璃与装配玻璃联合会

9.en: Researchers claim that the human personality is formed during the first two years of life, and during the first three years children learn the basic skills they will use in all their later learning both at home and at school.
parts: 研究人员认为，人的个性在出生后的头两年形成。
在头三年里，儿童会学到一些基本技能，此后无论在家还是在学校，学习时都会用到这些技能。
terms: both at home and at school
both at home and at school

5.en: The report argued for enhanced equity of access and better funding for childcare and early childhood education institutions.
parts: 报告主张，让人们有更公平的机会获得托育与幼儿教育服务，并为提供这些服务的机构改善经费保障。
terms: 获得服务机会的公平性

10.en: Once over the age of three, children continue to expand on existing knowledge of the world.
parts: 三岁以后，孩子们在已有认识的基础上，继续加深对世界的了解。

31.en: Parent resource centres, located in school buildings, offered learning materials for families and facilitators for child care.
parts: 设在校舍里的家长资源中心为家庭提供学习资料，还安排人员协助照看儿童。

7.en: A 13-year study of early childhood development at Harvard University has shown that, by the age of three, most children have the potential to understand about 1000 words – most of the language they will use in ordinary conversation for the rest of their lives.
parts: 哈佛大学一项历时13年的幼儿发展研究表明，到三岁时，大多数儿童就有能力理解约1000个词，
这些词占他们此后一生在日常交谈中所用词汇的大部分。
terms: for the rest of their lives
for the rest of their lives

23.en: The ‘Missouri’ programme was predicated on research showing that working with the family, rather than bypassing the parents, is the most effective way of helping children get off to the best possible start in life.
parts: “密苏里”项目所依据的研究表明，与家庭合作、让父母参与，是帮助孩子获得最佳人生起点的最有效方法。

24.en: The four-year pilot study included 380 families who were about to have their first child and who represented a cross-section of socio-economic status, age and family configurations.
parts: 这项为期四年的试点研究纳入了380个即将迎来第一个孩子的家庭，涵盖不同的社会经济状况、父母年龄和家庭结构。

27.en: Information on child development, and guidance on things to look for and expect as the child grows were provided, plus guidance in fostering the child’s intellectual, language, social and motor-skill development.
parts: 项目向家长介绍儿童发展知识，指导他们在孩子成长过程中留意哪些迹象、可以预期哪些变化，
还指导他们培养孩子的智力、语言能力、社交能力和运动技能。

30.en: Parent-educators made personal visits to homes and monthly group meetings were held with other new parents to share experience and discuss topics of interest.
parts: 家长教育辅导员会亲自上门家访，此外还每月组织新手父母聚会，让他们交流经验，讨论感兴趣的话题。

32.en: At the age of three, the children who had been involved in the “Missouri” programme were evaluated alongside a cross-section of children selected from the same range of socio-economic backgrounds and family situations, and also a random sample of children that age.
parts: 参加“密苏里”项目的儿童在三岁时接受了评估。
与他们一同接受评估的，一组是从相同范围的社会经济背景和家庭状况中选出的代表性儿童，另一组则是随机抽取的同龄儿童。

34.en: By the age of three, the children in the programme were significantly more advanced in language development than their peers, had made greater strides in problem solving and other intellectual skills, and were further along in social development.
parts: 到三岁时，参加项目的儿童在语言发展上已明显领先于同龄人，
在解决问题和其他智力技能上也取得了更大进步，社交能力的发展同样更为超前。

45.en: Their focus is on getting children and mothers access to childcare and institutionalised early childhood education.
parts: 他们关注的是如何让儿童和母亲获得托育服务，以及由专门机构提供的幼儿教育。

34.en: ‘Moreover, the loss of diversity may also deprive us of different ways of looking at the world,’ says Pagel.
parts: “而且，多样性的丧失还可能使我们失去从不同角度看待世界的机会，”佩格尔说。

24.en: Quite often, governments try to kill off a minority language by banning its use in public or discouraging its use in schools, all to promote national unity.
parts: 政府常常试图让一种少数群体语言消失：有的禁止在公共场合使用，有的则劝阻在学校使用，目的都是促进国家团结。

2.en: The study compared the proportion of wealth poured into transport by thirty-seven cities around the world.
parts: 这项研究比较了世界各地37座城市各自投入交通的资金占其财富的比例。

14.en: Newman, however, believes the study demonstrates that ‘the auto-dependent city model is inefficient and grossly inadequate in economic as well as environmental terms’.
parts: 纽曼则认为，研究表明，“依赖汽车的城市模式效率低下，而且从经济和环境两方面看都极不理想”。

15.en: Bicycle use was not included in the study but Newman noted that the two most ‘bicycle friendly’ cities considered – Amsterdam and Copenhagen – were very efficient, even though their public transport systems were ‘reasonable but not special’.
parts: 该研究没有把自行车出行纳入统计。但纽曼指出，在纳入考察的城市中，对骑自行车最友好的两座——阿姆斯特丹和哥本哈根——交通效率很高，
尽管它们的公共交通系统只算“尚可，没什么特别”。
terms: 阿姆斯特丹和哥本哈根

16.en: It is common for supporters of road networks to reject the models of cities with good public transport by arguing that such systems would not work in their particular city.
parts: 支持发展道路网的人常常不接受公共交通发达城市的做法，理由是那样的交通系统在他们自己的城市行不通。

39.en: In cities that developed later, the World Bank and Asian Development Bank discouraged the building of public transport and people have been forced to rely on cars – creating the massive traffic jams that characterize those cities.
parts: 在发展较晚的城市，世界银行和亚洲开发银行不鼓励建设公共交通。
人们被迫依赖汽车，造成了这些城市典型的严重交通拥堵。

45.en: The explanation for this seems to be that it is valuable to place people working in related fields together.
parts: 原因似乎在于，让从事相关领域工作的人聚集在一起很有价值。

46.en: ‘The new world will largely depend on human creativity, and creativity flourishes where people come together face-to-face.’
parts: “新世界将在很大程度上依赖人类的创造力，而创造力在人们面对面相聚时最为蓬勃。”

1.en: A new study conducted for the World Bank by Murdoch University’s Institute for Science and Technology Policy (ISTP) has demonstrated that public transport is more efficient than cars.
parts: 默多克大学科学技术政策研究所（ISTP）为世界银行开展的一项新研究表明，公共交通比汽车更高效。
terms: Institute for Science and Technology Policy
institute for science and technology policy

3.en: This included both the public and private costs of building, maintaining and using a transport system.
parts: 计算在内的有建设、维护和使用交通系统的成本，既包括公共支出，也包括私人支出。
terms: both the public and private costs
both the public and private costs
公共和私人两方面的成本

4.en: The study found that the Western Australian city of Perth is a good example of a city with minimal public transport.
parts: 研究发现，西澳大利亚州的珀斯就是公共交通服务十分有限的城市的一个典型例子。

5.en: As a result, 17% of its wealth went into transport costs.
parts: 因此，珀斯有17%的财富花在了交通上。

6.en: Some European and Asian cities, on the other hand, spent as little as 5%.
parts: 相比之下，有些欧洲和亚洲城市花在交通上的比例低至5%。

7.en: Professor Peter Newman, ISTP Director, pointed out that these more efficient cities were able to put the difference into attracting industry and jobs or creating a better place to live.
parts: 研究所所长彼得·纽曼教授指出，这些交通效率较高的城市可以把省下的钱用于吸引产业和就业机会，或改善居住环境。
terms: 两项交通开支之间的差额

8.en: According to Professor Newman, the larger Australian city of Melbourne is a rather unusual city in this sort of comparison.
parts: 据纽曼教授说，澳大利亚的墨尔本规模更大，在这类比较中是个颇不寻常的例子。

9.en: He describes it as two cities: ‘A European city surrounded by a car-dependent one’.
parts: 他把墨尔本形容为两座城：“一座欧洲式城市，外围又是一座依赖汽车的城市。”

10.en: Melbourne’s large tram network has made car use in the inner city much lower, but the outer suburbs have the same car-based structure as most other Australian cities.
parts: 墨尔本庞大的有轨电车网络使内城区的汽车使用率低得多；
但外围郊区和澳大利亚大多数其他城市一样，仍以汽车为中心布局。

11.en: The explosion in demand for accommodation in the inner suburbs of Melbourne suggests a recent change in many people’s preferences as to where they live.
parts: 墨尔本近郊的住房需求激增，表明近来许多人对居住地点的偏好发生了变化。

12.en: Newman says this is a new, broader way of considering public transport issues.
parts: 纽曼说，这提供了一个看待公共交通问题的新视角，而且比以往更宽广。

13.en: In the past, the case for public transport has been made on the basis of environmental and social justice considerations rather than economics.
parts: 过去，人们为公共交通辩护，依据的是对环境和社会公平的考虑，而非经济因素。

17.en: One objection is climate.
parts: 有人以气候为由提出反对。

18.en: Some people say their city could not make more use of public transport because it is either too hot or too cold.
parts: 有人说，自己的城市不是太热就是太冷，所以无法更多地利用公共交通。
terms: either too hot or too cold
either too hot or too cold

19.en: Newman rejects this, pointing out that public transport has been successful in both Toronto and Singapore and, in fact, he has checked the use of cars against climate and found ‘zero correlation’.
parts: 纽曼不同意这种说法。他指出，公共交通在多伦多和新加坡都很成功；
事实上，他比较过汽车使用情况和气候，发现两者的“相关性为零”。

20.en: When it comes to other physical features, road lobbies are on stronger ground.
parts: 说到其他地理条件，主张发展公路的游说团体就更有理由了。
terms: 主张发展公路的游说团体
论据更充分；更站得住脚

21.en: For example, Newman accepts it would be hard for a city as hilly as Auckland to develop a really good rail network.
parts: 比如，纽曼承认，像奥克兰这样丘陵密布的城市，要建成一个真正出色的铁路网确实很难。

22.en: However, he points out that both Hong Kong and Zurich have managed to make a success of their rail systems, heavy and light respectively, though there are few cities in the world as hilly.
parts: 不过，他指出，香港的重轨和苏黎世的轻轨都办得很成功，尽管世界上很少有城市像它们这样多丘陵。

23.en: In fact, Newman believes the main reason for adopting one sort of transport over another is politics: ‘The more democratic the process, the more public transport is favored.’
parts: 实际上，纽曼认为，城市选择某种交通方式而舍弃另一种，主要出于政治原因：“决策过程越民主，公共交通就越受支持。”

24.en: He considers Portland, Oregon, a perfect example of this.
parts: 他认为，俄勒冈州的波特兰市就是一个绝佳的例子。

25.en: Some years ago, federal money was granted to build a new road.
parts: 多年前，联邦政府曾拨款修建一条新路。

26.en: However, local pressure groups forced a referendum over whether to spend the money on light rail instead.
parts: 但在当地倡议团体的推动下，是否改用这笔钱修轻轨，必须交由公民投票决定。

27.en: The rail proposal won and the railway worked spectacularly well.
parts: 轻轨方案赢得了公投，建成后运营得非常成功。

28.en: In the years that have followed, more and more rail systems have been put in, dramatically changing the nature of the city.
parts: 此后几年，越来越多的轨道交通系统建了起来，城市的面貌也随之大为改观。
terms: In the years that have followed
in the years that have followed

29.en: Newman notes that Portland has about the same population as Perth and had a similar population density at the time.
parts: 纽曼指出，波特兰目前的人口与珀斯大致相当，当时两市的人口密度也相近。

30.en: In the UK, travel times to work had been stable for at least six centuries, with people avoiding situations that required them to spend more than half an hour travelling to work.
parts: 在英国，通勤时间曾至少六个世纪保持稳定，人们会避免需要花半个多小时去上班的情形。

31.en: Trains and cars initially allowed people to live at greater distances without taking longer to reach their destination.
parts: 起初，火车和汽车让人们可以住得更远，而到达目的地所用的时间并没有变长。

32.en: However, public infrastructure did not keep pace with urban sprawl, causing massive congestion problems which now make commuting times far higher.
parts: 然而，公共基础设施没有跟上城市向外扩张的速度，造成了严重的交通拥堵，如今人们的通勤时间因此长了许多。
terms: 高得多（指通勤时间更长）

33.en: There is a widespread belief that increasing wealth encourages people to live farther out where cars are the only viable transport.
parts: 人们普遍认为，财富增加会促使人们搬到离市中心更远的地方，而在那里，汽车是唯一可行的交通工具。

34.en: The example of European cities refutes that.
parts: 欧洲城市的例子驳斥了这种看法。

35.en: They are often wealthier than their American counterparts but have not generated the same level of car use.
parts: 这些欧洲城市往往比美国的同类城市更富裕，但其汽车使用量并没有美国城市那么高。

36.en: In Stockholm, car use has actually fallen in recent years as the city has become larger and wealthier.
parts: 近年来，斯德哥尔摩规模扩大、财富增加，汽车使用量却实际下降了。

37.en: A new study makes this point even more starkly.
parts: 一项新研究更鲜明地说明了这一点。

38.en: Developing cities in Asia, such as Jakarta and Bangkok, make more use of the car than wealthy Asian cities such as Tokyo and Singapore.
parts: 雅加达和曼谷等发展中的亚洲城市，比东京和新加坡等富裕的亚洲城市更常使用汽车。

40.en: Newman believes one of the best studies on how cities built for cars might be converted to rail use is The Urban Village report, which used Melbourne as an example.
parts: 纽曼认为，《城市村落》报告是探讨如何让原本围绕汽车建设的城市转向轨道交通的最佳研究之一。这份报告以墨尔本为例。

41.en: It found that pushing everyone into the city centre was not the best approach.
parts: 报告发现，让所有人都集中到市中心并非最佳办法。

42.en: Instead, the proposal advocated the creation of urban villages at hundreds of sites, mostly around railway stations.
parts: 报告主张在数百处地点建设城市村落，选址大多在火车站周边。

43.en: It was once assumed that improvements in telecommunications would lead to more dispersal in the population as people were no longer forced into cities.
parts: 人们一度以为，通信技术的进步会让人口分布更分散，因为人们再也不必聚居在城市里。

44.en: However, the ISTP team’s research demonstrates that the population and job density of cities rose or remained constant in the 1980s after decades of decline.
parts: 然而，该研究所的研究表明，经过数十年的下降后，城市的人口密度和就业岗位密度在20世纪80年代有所回升，或维持不变。
terms: 人口密度和就业岗位密度

37.en: The Acoma and San Ildefonso pueblos have established highly profitable pottery businesses, while the Navajo and Hopi groups have been similarly successful with jewellery.
parts: 阿科马和圣伊尔德丰索两个普韦布洛社群建立了利润丰厚的制陶业，
纳瓦霍人和霍皮人经营珠宝首饰也同样成功。

11.en: The writer Arthur Koestler dubbed it the luxury reflex: ‘unique in that it serves no apparent biological purpose’.
parts: 作家阿瑟·库斯勒把笑称为“奢侈的反射”，认为它“独特之处在于，它没有明显的生物学用途”。

49.en: As Peter Derks, a psychologist at William and Mary College in Virginia, says: ‘I like to think of humour as the distorted mirror of the mind.
parts: 正如弗吉尼亚州威廉与玛丽学院的心理学家彼得·德克斯所说：“我喜欢把幽默比作一面映照心智的哈哈镜。

50.en: It’s creative, perceptual, analytical and lingual.
parts: 幽默既涉及创造和感知，也涉及分析和语言。

51.en: If we can figure out how the mind processes humour, then we’ll have a pretty good handle on how it works in general.’
parts: 如果能弄清心智如何处理幽默，我们就能相当好地理解它通常是怎样运作的。”
terms: have a pretty good handle on
have a pretty good handle on

6.en: ‘Which side of a dog has the most hair?
parts: “狗的哪一面毛最多？

7.en: The outside.’
parts: 外面。”

26.en: Researchers believe social situations, rather than cognitive events such as jokes, trigger these instinctual markers of play or appeasement.
parts: 研究人员认为，引发这些本能信号的是社交情境，而非笑话之类的认知事件。这些信号表示在玩耍或是在安抚对方。

27.en: People laugh on fairground rides or when tickled to flag a play situation, whether they feel amused or not.
parts: 人们乘坐游乐设施或被挠痒时会笑，借此表明这是在玩耍，不管自己是否真的觉得有趣。
terms: 游乐场里可乘坐的设施

2.en: After years in the wilderness, the term ‘artificial intelligence’ (AI) seems poised to make a comeback.
parts: 沉寂多年之后，“人工智能”（AI）这个词似乎又要重新流行起来了。

4.en: Day length is an excellent cue, because it provides a perfectly predictable pattern of change within the year.
parts: 白昼的长短是个很好的信号，因为它在一年中的变化有完全可预测的规律。

2.en: The results of a 14-year study to be announced later this month reveal that the diseases associated with old age are afflicting fewer and fewer people and when they do strike, it is much later in life.
parts: 一项历时14年的研究将于本月晚些时候公布结果。结果显示，受老年相关疾病困扰的人越来越少，
即使发病，发病年龄也比过去晚得多。
terms: 在人生中晚得多的时候

4.en: Researchers, now analysing the results of data gathered in 1994, say arthritis, high blood pressure and circulation problems — the major medical complaints in this age group — are troubling a smaller proportion every year.
parts: 研究人员正在分析1994年收集的数据。他们说，关节炎、高血压和血液循环问题，
是这个年龄段最主要的健康问题。受这几种疾病困扰的人所占的比例逐年下降。

5.en: And the data confirms that the rate at which these diseases are declining continues to accelerate.
parts: 数据也证实，这些疾病在人群中所占的比例下降得越来越快。

6.en: Other diseases of old age – dementia, stroke, arteriosclerosis and emphysema – are also troubling fewer and fewer people.
parts: 痴呆、中风、动脉硬化和肺气肿等其他老年病，困扰的人也越来越少。

8.en: He says the problems doctors accepted as normal in a 65-year-old in 1982 are often not appearing until people are 70 or 75.
parts: 他说，1982年医生认为在65岁的人身上属正常的那些问题，现在往往要到70岁或75岁才出现。

9.en: Clearly, certain diseases are beating a retreat in the face of medical advances.
parts: 显然，随着医学进步，某些疾病正逐渐减少。

11.en: Improvements in childhood nutrition in the first quarter of the twentieth century, for example, gave today’s elderly people a better start in life than their predecessors.
parts: 例如，在20世纪头25年里，儿童营养的改善使今天这代老年人的人生起点好于前辈。

14.en: ‘These may be subtle influences,’ says Manton, ‘but our subjects have been exposed to worse and worse pollution for over 60 years.
parts: “这些因素的影响也许并不明显，”曼顿说，“但我们的研究对象在六十多年里一直暴露在日益严重的污染中。

15.en: It’s not surprising we see some effect.’
parts: 我们能看到一些影响，并不奇怪。”

16.en: One interesting correlation Manton uncovered is that better-educated people are likely to live longer.
parts: 曼顿发现了一项有意思的关联：受教育程度较高的人往往更长寿。

17.en: For example, 65-year-old women with fewer than eight years of schooling are expected, on average, to live to 82.
parts: 例如，受教育不足八年的65岁女性，预计平均能活到82岁。

19.en: Although some of this can be attributed to a higher income, Manton believes it is mainly because educated people seek more medical attention.
parts: 收入较高可以解释其中的一部分差异，但曼顿认为，主要原因是受过教育的人更常就医。

20.en: The survey also assessed how independent people over 65 were, and again found a striking trend.
parts: 调查还评估了65岁以上人群独立生活的程度，同样发现了一个引人注目的趋势。

21.en: Almost 80% of those in the 1994 survey could complete everyday activities ranging from eating and dressing unaided to complex tasks such as cooking and managing their finances.
parts: 在1994年的受访者中，近80%能完成各类日常活动，从自己吃饭、穿衣，
到做饭、理财这样较为复杂的事情。

22.en: That represents a significant drop in the number of disabled old people in the population.
parts: 这表明，人口中失能老年人的数量显著减少了。

23.en: If the trends apparent in the United States 14 years ago had continued, researchers calculate there would be an additional one million disabled elderly people in today’s population.
parts: 据研究人员推算，如果美国14年前显现的趋势延续至今，今天还会多出100万名失能老人。

24.en: According to Manton, slowing the trend has saved the United States government’s Medicare system more than $200 billion, suggesting that the greying of America’s population may prove less of a financial burden than expected.
parts: 曼顿说，这一趋势的放缓已为美国政府的联邦医疗保险计划节省了2000多亿美元。
这表明，美国人口老龄化带来的财政负担可能比预想的轻。
terms: 美国联邦医疗保险计划

25.en: The increasing self-reliance of many elderly people is probably linked to a massive increase in the use of simple home medical aids.
parts: 许多老年人越来越能自理，这可能与家用简易医疗辅助器具的使用大幅增加有关。

26.en: For instance, the use of raised toilet seats has more than doubled since the start of the study, and the use of bath seats has grown by more than 50%.
parts: 例如，跟研究刚开始时相比，加高马桶座圈的使用量已超过原来的两倍，洗澡椅的使用量则增加了50%以上。

29.en: Maintaining a level of daily physical activity may help mental functioning, says Carl Cotman, a neuroscientist at the University of California at Irvine.
parts: 加州大学欧文分校的神经科学家卡尔·科特曼说，每天保持一定的体力活动，可能有益于心智功能。

30.en: He found that rats that exercise on a treadmill have raised levels of brain-derived neurotrophic factor coursing through their brains.
parts: 他发现，在跑步机上运动的大鼠，脑内流动的脑源性神经营养因子水平较高。

37.en: The research suggests that older people fare best when they feel independent but know they can get help when they need it.
parts: 研究表明，老年人如果觉得自己能独立生活，同时知道需要时有人帮忙，状态就最好。

38.en: ‘Like much research into ageing, these results support common sense,’ says Seeman.
parts: 塞曼说：“这与许多有关老龄化的研究一样，研究结果印证了常识。”

40.en: ‘The sort of thing that your grandmother always told you turns out to be right on target,’ she says.
parts: 她说：“你祖母常跟你讲的那些道理，到头来还真说对了。”

7.en: ‘It really raises the question of what should be considered normal ageing,’ says Kenneth Manton, a demographer from Duke University in North Carolina.
parts: “这确实引出了一个问题：究竟怎样才算正常衰老？”北卡罗来纳州杜克大学的人口学家肯尼思·曼顿说。

32.en: As part of the same study, Teresa Seeman, a social epidemiologist at the University of Southern California in Los Angeles, found a connection between self-esteem and stress in people over 70.
parts: 在同一项研究中，洛杉矶南加州大学的社会流行病学家特蕾莎·塞曼发现，
在70岁以上的人群中，自尊与压力之间存在关联。

3.en: Inuit families going off on snowmobiles to prepare their summer hunting camps have found themselves cut off from home by a sea of mud, following early thaws.
parts: 有些因纽特家庭骑雪地摩托出去准备夏季狩猎营地，却发现冰雪提早消融，遍地泥泞，回家的路被阻断了。

5.en: Climate change may still be a rather abstract idea to most of us, but in the Arctic it is already having dramatic effects — if summertime ice continues to shrink at its present rate, the Arctic Ocean could soon become virtually ice-free in summer.
parts: 对我们大多数人来说，气候变化可能仍是个相当抽象的概念，但它已给北极带来显著影响。
如果夏季海冰继续以目前的速度消退，北冰洋或许很快就会在夏天几乎没有海冰。

7.en: Scientists are increasingly keen to find out what’s going on because they consider the Arctic the ‘canary in the mine’ for global warming — a warning of what’s in store for the rest of the world.
parts: 科学家们越来越想弄清楚北极正在发生什么，因为他们把北极看作全球变暖的“矿井里的金丝雀”，
它预示着世界其他地方将会面临什么。

16.en: Farming is out of the question and nature offers meagre pickings.
parts: 这里根本无法耕作，大自然所能提供的食物也少得可怜。

17.en: Humans first settled in the Arctic a mere 4,500 years ago, surviving by exploiting sea mammals and fish.
parts: 人类直到4500年前才首次在北极定居，靠捕猎海洋哺乳动物和捕鱼为生。

20.en: These Thule people moved in from Alaska, bringing kayaks, sleds, dogs, pottery and iron tools.
parts: 这些图勒人从阿拉斯加迁来，带来了皮艇、雪橇、狗、陶器和铁制工具。

22.en: Life for the descendants of the Thule people is still harsh.
parts: 图勒人的后代至今仍过着艰苦的生活。

24.en: It’s currently home to 2,500 people, all but a handful of them indigenous Inuit.
parts: 这里现有2500名居民，除少数人外，其余都是当地原住的因纽特人。

25.en: Over the past 40 years, most have abandoned their nomadic ways and settled in the territory’s 28 isolated communities, but they still rely heavily on nature to provide food and clothing.
parts: 过去40年间，大多数因纽特人放弃了游居生活，在这块领地上28个偏远的社区定居，
但他们所需的食物和衣物仍在很大程度上取自大自然。

27.en: It would cost a family around £7,000 a year to replace meat they obtained themselves through hunting with imported meat.
parts: 一家人如果把自家打猎所得的肉换成进口肉，一年大约得花7000英镑。

29.en: While the Inuit may not actually starve if hunting and trapping are curtailed by climate change, there has certainly been an impact on people’s health.
parts: 即使气候变化限制了狩猎和设陷捕猎，因纽特人也未必真会挨饿，
但人们的健康确实已经受到了影响。

31.en: There has been a crisis of identity as the traditional skills of hunting, trapping and preparing skins have begun to disappear.
parts: 狩猎、设陷捕猎和处理兽皮的传统技艺开始消失，因纽特人也因此面临身份认同危机。

32.en: In Nunavut’s ‘igloo and email’ society, where adults who were born in igloos have children who may never have been out on the land, there’s a high incidence of depression.
parts: 在努纳武特这个“冰屋与电子邮件并存”的社会里，有的父母出生在冰屋中，而子女可能从未到过野外。这里的抑郁症发病率很高。

33.en: With so much at stake, the Inuit are determined to play a key role in teasing out the mysteries of climate change in the Arctic.
parts: 这件事关系重大。因纽特人决心在解开北极气候变化之谜的过程中发挥关键作用。

35.en: And Western scientists are starting to draw on this wisdom, increasingly referred to as ‘Inuit Qaujimajatuqangit’, or IQ.
parts: 西方科学家也开始借鉴这种智慧。人们越来越常用因纽特语名称 Inuit Qaujimajatuqangit 来称呼它，简称 IQ。
terms: 因纽特传统知识的简称

36.en: ‘In the early days scientists ignored us when they came up here to study anything.
parts: “早些年，科学家到这儿来，不管研究什么都不理会我们。

37.en: They just figured these people don’t know very much so we won’t ask them,’ says John Amagoalik, an Inuit leader and politician.
parts: 他们就是觉得，‘这些人懂得不多，我们就不问他们了。’”因纽特人领袖、政治家约翰·阿马戈阿利克说。

38.en: ‘But in recent years IQ has had much more credibility and weight.’
parts: “不过，近几年，因纽特传统知识的可信度和影响力都提高了许多。”
terms: 因纽特传统知识的简称

39.en: In fact it is now a requirement for anyone hoping to get permission to do research that they consult the communities, who are helping to set the research agenda to reflect their most important concerns.
parts: 事实上，如今任何人要取得研究许可，都必须先征询当地社区的意见。
这些社区正参与制定研究议程，让它体现自己最关心的问题。

40.en: They can turn down applications from scientists they believe will work against their interests, or research projects that will impinge too much on their daily lives and traditional activities.
parts: 如果社区认为某位科学家的工作会损害本社区的利益，便可拒绝其申请。对日常生活和传统活动干扰过多的研究项目，社区也可以拒绝。

43.en: There are still huge gaps in our environmental knowledge, and despite the scientific onslaught, many predictions are no more than best guesses.
parts: 我们对环境的认识还有很大空白。尽管科学研究在大力推进，许多预测也不过是根据现有信息作出的推测。
terms: 据现有信息所作的推测

44.en: IQ could help to bridge the gap and resolve the tremendous uncertainty about how much of what we’re seeing is natural capriciousness and how much is the consequence of human activity.
parts: 因纽特人的传统知识或许能帮助填补这一空白，解开一个至今很难说准的问题：
我们所看到的变化，有多少出自自然本身的变幻，又有多少是人类活动造成的？
terms: 因纽特传统知识的简称

4.en: There are reports of igloos losing their insulating properties as the snow drips and refreezes, of lakes draining into the sea as permafrost melts, and sea ice breaking up earlier than usual, carrying seals beyond the reach of hunters.
parts: 有消息说，积雪融化滴落后又结冰，冰屋因此失去了隔热性能，
永久冻土融化，湖水由此流入海里，
海冰也比往年更早破裂，载着海豹漂到了猎人够不到的地方。

12.en: In Canada, where the Inuit people are jealously guarding their hard-won autonomy in the country’s newest territory, Nunavut, they believe their best hope of survival in this changing environment lies in combining their ancestral knowledge with the best of modern science.
parts: 在加拿大，因纽特人悉心守护着他们在该国新设的努纳武特地区争得的自治权。
他们相信，要在变化中的环境里生存，最大的希望在于把祖传知识与现代科学的精华结合起来。

18.en: The environment tested them to the limits: sometimes the colonists were successful, sometimes they failed and vanished.
parts: 环境给了他们最严峻的考验。有些定居者成功立足，有些没能生存下去，最终销声匿迹。

23.en: Nunavut is 1.9 million square kilometres of rock and ice, and a handful of islands around the North Pole.
parts: 努纳武特有190万平方公里的岩石和冰原，还包括北极点附近的几座岛屿。

30.en: Obesity, heart disease and diabetes are beginning to appear in a people for whom these have never before been problems.
parts: 肥胖、心脏病和糖尿病正开始出现在因纽特人当中，这些疾病过去从未困扰过这个民族。

1.en: The threat posed by climate change in the Arctic and the problems faced by Canada’s Inuit people
parts: 气候变化给北极带来的威胁，以及加拿大因纽特人面临的问题

2.en: Unusual incidents are being reported across the Arctic.
parts: 北极各地陆续传来关于异常事件的报道。

6.en: The knock-on effects are likely to include more warming, cloudier skies, increased precipitation and higher sea levels.
parts: 随之而来的连锁影响可能包括气候进一步变暖、云量增多、降水增加和海平面上升。

8.en: For the Inuit the problem is urgent.
parts: 对因纽特人来说，这是个迫在眉睫的问题。

9.en: They live in precarious balance with one of the toughest environments on earth.
parts: 他们与地球上最严酷的环境之一维系着一种脆弱的平衡。

10.en: Climate change, whatever its causes, is a direct threat to their way of life.
parts: 不论起因是什么，气候变化都直接威胁着他们的生活方式。

11.en: Nobody knows the Arctic as well as the locals, which is why they are not content simply to stand back and let outside experts tell them what’s happening.
parts: 没有人比当地人更了解北极。正因如此，他们不甘心只在一旁听外来的专家告诉自己这里正发生什么。

13.en: This is a challenge in itself.
parts: 这件事本身就是一项挑战。

14.en: The Canadian Arctic is a vast, treeless polar desert that’s covered with snow for most of the year.
parts: 加拿大北极地区是一片辽阔而不长树木的极地荒漠，一年中大部分时间都被积雪覆盖。

15.en: Venture into this terrain and you get some idea of the hardships facing anyone who calls this home.
parts: 只要走进这片土地，你就多少能体会到以这里为家的人所面对的艰辛。

19.en: But around a thousand years ago, one group emerged that was uniquely well adapted to cope with the Arctic environment.
parts: 不过，大约一千年前出现了一个群体，他们格外能适应北极的生存环境。

21.en: They are the ancestors of today’s Inuit people.
parts: 他们就是今天因纽特人的祖先。
terms: 今天；当今（此处用所有格）

26.en: Provisions available in local shops have to be flown into Nunavut on one of the most costly air networks in the world, or brought by supply ship during the few ice-free weeks of summer.
parts: 当地商店出售的物资要么经由全球费用最高的航空运输网络之一运入努纳武特，
要么趁夏季短短几周的无冰期，由补给船运来。

28.en: Economic opportunities are scarce, and for many people state benefits are their only income.
parts: 当地的谋生机会很少，对许多人来说，政府补助是唯一的收入来源。

34.en: Having survived there for centuries, they believe their wealth of traditional knowledge is vital to the task.
parts: 他们已在这里生存了数百年，相信自己丰富的传统知识对于这项工作至关重要。

41.en: Some scientists doubt the value of traditional knowledge because the occupation of the Arctic doesn’t go back far enough.
parts: 有些科学家怀疑传统知识的价值，因为人类在北极定居的历史还不够久。

42.en: Others, however, point out that the first weather stations in the far north date back just 50 years.
parts: 不过，另一部分科学家指出，极北地区最早的气象站也不过是在五十年前才设立的。

1.en: The Lumiere Brothers opened their Cinematographe, at 14 Boulevard des Capucines in Paris, to 100 paying customers over 100 years ago, on December 8, 1895.
parts: 一百多年前，1895年12月8日，卢米埃尔兄弟在巴黎卡普西纳大道14号，向100名购票观众公开展示了他们的电影放映机。
terms: 卢米埃尔兄弟的电影机

2.en: Before the eyes of the stunned, thrilled audience, photographs came to life and moved across a flat screen.
parts: 在惊愕又兴奋的观众眼前，照片活了起来，画面在平平的银幕上动了起来。

3.en: So ordinary and routine has this become to us that it takes a determined leap of the imagination to grasp the impact of those first moving images.
parts: 活动影像对我们来说早已司空见惯，要体会最初那些影像给人带来的震撼，得着实发挥一番想象力。

4.en: But it is worth trying, for to understand the initial shock of those images is to understand the extraordinary power and magic of cinema, the unique, hypnotic quality that has made film the most dynamic, effective art form of the 20th century.
parts: 但这值得一试。因为要了解那些影像最初给人的震撼，就是要了解电影非凡的力量和魔力，
正是这种独有的、令人着迷的特质，使电影成为20世纪最有活力、最能打动人的艺术形式。

9.en: ‘As the train approached,’ wrote Tarkovsky, ‘panic started in the theatre: people jumped and ran away.
parts: “火车驶近时，”塔可夫斯基写道，“影院里顿时一片惊慌：人们跳起来跑开了。
